examples.en: She has been ill.

topics.summary: take-took-taken等动作类不规则动词
topics.detail:
take/make/find/give变形不规则。
注意过去式和过去分词的拼写和发音。

examples.en: He took the book.

topics.title: 不规则动词：say/see/hear/tell
topics.summary: say-said-said等交流感知类
topics.detail:
say/see/hear/tell不规则变化。
注意过去式和过去分词的拼写和发音。

examples.en: She said hello.

topics.title: 不规则动词：begin/write/drive/ring
topics.summary: begin-began-begun等i-a-u型
topics.detail:
begin/write/drive/ring遵循i-a-u变化。
注意过去式和过去分词的拼写和发音。

topics.title: 不规则动词：think/bring/buy/teach

topics.detail:
think/bring/buy/teach以ought/aught结尾。
注意过去式和过去分词的拼写和发音。

catch/fight/seek/feel变化。

topics.title: 时间状语从句when
topics.summary: when引导，表'当…时'
topics.detail: when+从句，主句。表同时或先后。

examples.en: When I arrived, he was sleeping.

topics.title: 时间状语从句while
topics.summary: while引导，表'当…时'(同时进行)
topics.detail: while+进行时从句，主句。强调同时。

examples.en: While I was reading, he called.

topics.title: 时间状语从句before
topics.summary: before引导，表'在…之前'
topics.detail: before+从句，主句动作先于从句。

examples.en: Finish before he comes.

topics.title: 时间状语从句after
topics.summary: after引导，表'在…之后'
topics.detail: after+从句，主句动作后于从句。

examples.en: After he left, I cried.

topics.title: 时间状语从句since
topics.summary: since引导，表'自从…'
topics.detail: since+过去时从句，主句用完成时。

examples.en: I have known him since we met.

topics.title: 时间状语从句until/till
topics.summary: until引导，表'直到…才'
topics.detail: not...until直到…才。

examples.en: I won't leave until you come.

topics.title: 原因状语从句because
topics.summary: because引导，表原因
topics.detail: because+从句，回答why提问。

examples.en: I stayed because it rained.

topics.title: 条件状语从句if
topics.summary: if引导，表条件
topics.detail: if+从句，主句。主将从现。

examples.en: If it rains, I'll stay.

topics.title: 条件状语从句unless
topics.summary: unless=if not，除非
topics.detail: unless+肯定句=if+否定句。

examples.en: I'll go unless it rains.

topics.title: 让步状语从句although
topics.summary: although引导，表'虽然'
topics.detail: although+从句，主句。不与but连用。

examples.en: Although tired, he worked on.

topics.title: 目的状语从句so that
topics.summary: so that引导，表'以便'
topics.detail: so that+从句(常含can/will)。

examples.en: I got up early so that I could catch the train.

topics.title: 结果状语从句so...that
topics.summary: so+adj/adv+that，表'如此…以至于'
topics.detail: so+修饰语+that+结果。

examples.en: It was so cold that I shivered.

topics.title: 方式状语从句as
topics.summary: as引导，表'如同/像'
topics.detail: as+从句，主句。

examples.en: Do as I do.

topics.title: 比较状语从句than
topics.summary: than引导，表比较
topics.detail: 比较级+than+从句。

examples.en: She is taller than he is.

topics.title: 地点状语从句where
topics.summary: where引导，表'在…的地方'
topics.detail: where+从句，主句。

examples.en: Sit where you like.

topics.title: 不定式作主语
topics.summary: To do作主语，可用it作形式主语
topics.detail: To learn English is important. = It is important to learn English.

examples.en: To err is human.

topics.title: 不定式作宾语
topics.summary: decide/hope/want等后接to do
topics.detail: want/decide/hope/plan/agree+to do。

examples.en: I decided to leave.

topics.title: 不定式表目的
topics.summary: to do表目的'为了'
topics.detail: To do放句首或句末表目的。

examples.en: I came to help.

topics.title: 动名词作主语
topics.summary: Ving作主语谓语单数
topics.detail: 动名词作主语表已知/习惯。

examples.en: Swimming is fun.

topics.title: 动名词作宾语
topics.summary: enjoy/finish/mind等后接Ving
topics.detail: enjoy/finish/mind/practice/avoid+Ving。

examples.en: I enjoy reading.

topics.title: 介词后动名词
topics.summary: 介词后接Ving
topics.detail: 介词后必须用Ving不用to do。

examples.en: She is good at singing.

topics.title: 现在分词作定语
topics.summary: Ving作定语表主动/进行
topics.detail: the sleeping baby(正在睡的婴儿)。

examples.en: The crying baby is hungry.

topics.title: 过去分词作定语
topics.summary: V-ed作定语表被动/完成
topics.detail: the broken window(被打破的窗)。

examples.en: The broken cup is useless.

topics.title: 分词作状语
topics.summary: Ving/V-ed作状语
topics.detail: Seeing the teacher, I stood up. / Seen from above, it looks small.

examples.en: Walking home, I met Tom.

topics.title: 分词作宾补
topics.summary: see/hear sb doing/done
topics.detail: see sb do(全过程)/doing(正在)/done(被动)。

examples.en: I saw him crossing the street.

topics.title: 独立主格
topics.summary: 名词+分词，有自己的逻辑主语
topics.detail: Weather permitting, we'll go out. 主语与主句不同。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we'll go out.

topics.title: with复合结构
topics.summary: with+宾语+补语(分词/形容词/介词)
topics.detail: with him standing there, with the door open

examples.en: He slept with the window open.

topics.title: 不定式与动名词区别
topics.summary: 接to do表将来/目的，接Ving表习惯/进行
topics.detail: remember to do(记得要做)/doing(记得做过)。

examples.en: Remember to lock the door.

topics.title: stop to do vs doing
topics.summary: stop to do停下来去做/stop doing停止做
topics.detail: stop to rest(停下来休息)/stop talking(停止说话)。

examples.en: Stop talking, please.

topics.title: 被动不定式
topics.summary: to be done表被动
topics.detail: to be+过去分词表被发生。

examples.en: He wants to be promoted.

topics.title: 可数与不可数名词
topics.summary: 可数有单复数可用a/an，不可数不可直接计数
topics.detail:
可数名词有单复数形式，可用a/an修饰，如a book/two books。
不可数名词无复数，不可用a/an，如water/information/advice。
计量用量词：a piece of advice, a glass of water。
常见不可数：furniture, luggage, equipment, homework, knowledge, news。

examples.en: I have two books.
She gave me advice.

topics.title: 名词复数构成
topics.summary: 一般加s，s/x/ch/sh结尾加es，辅音+y变i加es
topics.detail: 规则：一般加s(book→books)；s/x/ch/sh加es(bus→buses, watch→watches)；辅音+y变i加es(city→cities)；f/fe变v加es(leaf→leaves)；o结尾有生命加es(potato→potatoes)，无生命加s(photo→photos)。

examples.en: There are many cities in China.
She bought two knives.

topics.title: 不规则名词复数
topics.summary: man→men, child→children, foot→feet等特殊变化
topics.detail: 不规则复数需单独记忆：变元音(man→men, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice)；加en(child→children, ox→oxen)；单复同形(sheep, deer, fish, series)；外来词(analysis→analyses, datum→data, phenomenon→phenomena)。

examples.en: Two men and three women are waiting.
The children are playing with mice.

topics.title: 集体名词
topics.summary: family/team/class表集合体，谓语可单可复
topics.detail:
集体名词如family/team/class/group/audience/committee/police。
整体看谓语单数：My family is large.
强调个体谓语复数：My family are watching TV.
police和cattle永远用复数：The police are coming.

examples.en: My family is going on a trip.
The committee are divided.

topics.title: 专有名词
topics.summary: 人名地名等首字母大写，通常不加冠词
topics.detail:
专有名词首字母大写。通常不加冠词：China, Beijing, John, Monday。
由普通名词组成加the：the United States, the Great Wall。
复数专有名词加the：the Alps, the Philippines。
江河海洋加the：the Yangtze, the Pacific。

examples.en: She lives in New York.
The Great Wall is famous.

topics.title: 物质名词
topics.summary: water/bread/iron等表物质，通常不可数
topics.detail:
物质名词表材料物质，不可数：water, milk, bread, meat, rice, paper, wood, iron, gold, glass。
计量用量词：a glass of water, a loaf of bread, a piece of meat, a bar of chocolate。
表种类可用复数：fruits(各种水果), steels(各种钢)。

examples.en: I'd like a glass of milk.
This ring is made of gold.

topics.title: 抽象名词
topics.summary: happiness/freedom等表概念品质，通常不可数
topics.detail:
抽象名词表品质/状态/概念，一般不可数：happiness, freedom, love, courage, knowledge, information, advice, news, progress。
有些可加a/an表实例：a success(成功的事), a knowledge of English。
常用后缀：-ness/-tion/-ment/-ity/-ship。

examples.en: Happiness is more important than wealth.
We made great progress.

topics.title: 名词所有格's
topics.summary: 有生命事物加's表示所属关系
topics.detail:
单数加's：Tom's book, my mother's car。
以s结尾复数加'：the students' room。
不以s结尾复数加's：children's day。
并列各有各自加：Tom's and Mary's books；共有最后加：Tom and Mary's room。
表时间/距离：today's news, a week's holiday。

examples.en: This is Tom's bicycle.
It is Women's Day.

topics.title: of所有格
topics.summary: 用of表示无生命事物的所属关系
topics.detail:
of所有格用于无生命名词：the door of the room, the title of the book。
有生命名词较长时也可用of：the plays of Shakespeare。
of还可表同位/数量：the City of Beijing, a cup of tea。
有生命优先's，无生命用of。

examples.en: The cover of the book is red.
What is the title of the movie?

topics.title: 双重所有格
topics.summary: a friend of mine结构兼用of和物主代词
topics.detail:
双重所有格：限定词+名词+of+名词性物主代词/所有格。
a friend of mine, two books of hers, a friend of my father's。
of前须有限定词(a/an/this/some/数词)。
表部分所属，暗含'中的一个'。

examples.en: He is a friend of mine.
This is a book of my father's.

topics.title: 复合名词
topics.summary: 两词组合成新名词如bookstore, mother-in-law
topics.detail:
书写形式：合写(bookstore, classroom)；分写(bus stop, ice cream)；连字符(mother-in-law)。
复数在中心词后加s：bookstores, bus stops。
含连字符在主要名词后加s：mothers-in-law, editors-in-chief。

examples.en: I bought books at the bookstore.
The check-in counter is there.

topics.title: 不可数名词计量表达
topics.summary: 用a piece of, a cup of等量词计量不可数名词
topics.detail:
量词搭配：a piece of(advice/news/music), a glass of water, a bottle of milk, a loaf of bread, a bar of chocolate, a slice of pizza, a sheet of paper, a grain of rice, a drop of water。
量词可变复数：two cups of coffee。

examples.en: I need a piece of paper.
She ate a slice of pizza.

topics.title: 单复数同形名词
topics.summary: sheep/deer/fish/series等单复数不变
topics.detail:
单复数同形：sheep, deer, fish, salmon, series, species, aircraft, means, headquarters。
根据限定词和谓语判断单复数：this sheep is / these sheep are。
fish表同种用单数，表多种用fishes。

examples.en: One sheep is missing.
Several aircraft were seen.

topics.title: 单复数意义不同的名词
topics.summary: glass/glasses, paper/papers等单复数意义不同
topics.detail: glass(玻璃)/glasses(眼镜)；paper(纸)/papers(文件)；time(时间)/times(时代)；work(工作)/works(作品/工厂)；iron(铁)/irons(熨斗)；people(人们)/peoples(民族)；custom(风俗)/customs(海关)。

examples.en: She wears glasses to read papers.
Times have changed.

topics.title: 名词常见后缀
topics.summary: -er/-or/-tion/-ment/-ness/-ity等后缀构名词
topics.detail:
表人：-er(teacher), -or(actor), -ist(scientist), -ian(musician)。
表动作：-tion(education), -ment(development)。
表品质：-ness(happiness), -ity(ability)。
表抽象：-hood(childhood), -ship(friendship), -dom(freedom)。

examples.en: The teacher explained education.
His happiness comes from friendship.

topics.title: 形容词比较级
topics.summary: 单音节加er，多音节加more，后接than
topics.detail:
构成：单音节加-er(tall→taller)；以e加-r(nice→nicer)；重读闭音节双写(big→bigger)；辅音+y变i加er(happy→happier)；多音节加more(beautiful→more beautiful)。
句型：A is+比较级+than B。

examples.en: Tom is taller than Jack.
This is more interesting.

topics.title: 形容词最高级
topics.summary: 单音节加est，多音节加most，前加the
topics.detail:
构成：单音节加-est(tallest)；以e加-st(largest)；双写加est(biggest)；变i加est(happiest)；多音节加most(most beautiful)。
用法：前加the；比较范围in/of；one of the+最高级+复数。

examples.en: She is the tallest in the class.
This is one of the best books.

topics.title: 不规则形容词比较等级
topics.summary: good→better→best, bad→worse→worst等
topics.detail:
good/well→better→best；bad/ill→worse→worst；many/much→more→most；little→less→least；far→farther/further→farthest/furthest；old→older/elder→oldest/eldest。
elder表家庭长幼不与than连用。

examples.en: This is the best movie.
My health is worse than before.

topics.title: 形容词排列顺序
topics.summary: 限定+主观+大小+年龄+颜色+产地+材质+用途+名词
topics.detail:
口诀：限观大龄色产地材途名。
顺序：限定词→观点(beautiful)→大小(big)→年龄(old)→颜色(red)→产地(Chinese)→材质(wooden)→用途(sports)→名词。
例：a beautiful large old red Chinese wooden dining table。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful small white silk dress.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件漂亮的小号白色丝绸裙。

examples.en: I bought a large old brown wooden table.
examples.cn: 我买了一张大的旧棕色木桌。

topics.title: -ed与-ing形容词
topics.summary: -ed表感受修饰人，-ing表特征修饰物
topics.detail:
-ing形容词表事物特征'令人…的'：interesting, exciting, boring, surprising。
-ed形容词表人感受'感到…的'：interested, excited, bored, surprised。
人作主语用-ed，物作主语用-ing。

examples.en: The movie was boring; I was bored.
The news is exciting; we are excited.
examples.cn: 消息令人兴奋，我们兴奋。

topics.title: 表语形容词
topics.summary: afraid/alive/alone/asleep只作表语不作定语
topics.detail:
以a-开头的形容词只作表语：afraid, alive, alone, asleep, awake, aware, ashamed, alike。
作定语需换词：the afraid boy→the frightened boy；the asleep baby→the sleeping baby；an ill person→a sick person。
alone(独自)vs lonely(孤独)。

examples.en: I am afraid of dogs.
The baby is asleep.

topics.title: 形容词后缀
topics.summary: -ful/-less/-ous/-ive/-al/-y等后缀构形容词
topics.detail: -ful(beautiful, careful, useful)；-less(careless, useless, hopeless)；-ous(dangerous, famous, nervous)；-ive(active, creative, effective)；-al(natural, cultural, educational)；-y(sunny, healthy, noisy)。

examples.en: She is a creative artist.
examples.cn: 她是有创造力的艺术家。

examples.en: The weather is sunny today.

topics.title: enough的位置
topics.summary: enough修饰形/副在后，修饰名词前后均可
topics.detail:
enough作副词修饰形/副放其后：good enough, old enough, fast enough。
enough作形容词修饰名词可前后：enough money / money enough。
enough...to do：old enough to drive。
too...to：too tired to walk。

examples.en: He is old enough to drive.
We don't have enough money.

topics.title: as...as同级比较
topics.summary: as+原级+as表同等，否定用not as/so...as
topics.detail:
肯定：as+原级+as。否定：not as/so+原级+as。
倍数放第一个as前：twice as big as, three times as long as。
as...as possible=尽可能：as soon as possible。
第二个as后可省略比较对象。

examples.en: He is as tall as his brother.
This room is twice as big.

topics.title: 比较级修饰词
topics.summary: much/a lot/far/even加强，a little/a bit减弱
topics.detail:
加强比较级：much better, a lot taller, far more important, even worse, still higher。
减弱比较级：a little better, a bit cheaper, slightly higher。
精确比较：two years older, three meters longer。
注意：very不修饰比较级，用much。

examples.en: This is much better.
She is a little taller.

topics.title: own的用法
topics.summary: own强调所属，放在物主代词后
topics.detail:
own放物主代词后：my own room, his own car。
on one's own=独自/靠自己：I did it on my own。
of one's own=属于自己的：He has a house of his own。
own也作动词'拥有'。

examples.en: I saw it with my own eyes.
She runs her own business.

topics.title: 数量形容词some/any
topics.summary: some用于肯定，any用于否定和疑问
topics.detail:
some用于肯定句：I have some money。
any用于否定/疑问：I don't have any. / Do you have any?
some可用于疑问句表请求：Would you like some tea?
any用于肯定表'任何'：Any student can join。
复合词：someone/anything/nobody。

examples.en: There are some apples.
Would you like some tea?

topics.title: 时间副词
topics.summary: now/today/yesterday等表时间，放句首或句末
topics.detail:
时间副词：now, today, yesterday, tomorrow, soon, already, just, still, yet, recently, lately, ago, before。
位置：通常句末(I saw him yesterday)；强调时句首(Yesterday I went there)；already/just放句中(She has already left)。

examples.en: I will finish it tomorrow.
Yesterday we went to the zoo.

topics.title: 地点副词
topics.summary: here/there/outside等表地点，放句末
topics.detail:
地点副词：here, there, everywhere, nowhere, somewhere, anywhere, abroad, home, upstairs, downstairs, nearby, ahead。
位置：通常句末(Come here)；强调时句首(Here comes the bus)。
home/abroad前不加to：go home, go abroad。

examples.en: Please come here.
They went abroad last year.

topics.title: 程度副词
topics.summary: very/quite/too/rather等修饰形容词表程度
topics.detail:
程度副词：very(很), quite(相当), too(太), so(如此), rather(颇), pretty(相当), fairly(还算), extremely(极其), completely(完全), slightly(稍微), a little(一点)。
very修饰原级不修饰比较级；比较级用much。

examples.en: She is very happy.
It is rather cold.

topics.title: 方式副词
topics.summary: quickly/carefully/well等表方式，放动词后
topics.detail:
方式副词表动作方式：quickly, carefully, slowly, happily, beautifully, well, fast, hard。
多数由形容词+ly构成。不规则：good→well, fast→fast, hard→hard。
位置：动词后或宾语后(She sings beautifully)。
注意：hard(努力)vs hardly(几乎不)；late(迟)vs lately(最近)。

examples.en: She speaks English fluently.
He works hard.

topics.title: 频率副词
topics.summary: always/usually/often等表频率，放be后实义动词前
topics.detail:
频率从高到低：always(总是)>usually(通常)>often(经常)>sometimes(有时)>seldom(很少)>never(从不)。
位置：be动词后(She is always late)；实义动词前(I always get up early)；助动词后(I have never been)。
提问用How often。

examples.en: She is always the first to arrive.
I usually have breakfast at seven.

topics.title: 副词位置规则
topics.summary: 频率副词be后实义动词前，方式→地点→时间顺序
topics.detail:
基本位置：句首(连接副词)、句中(be/助动词后实义动词前)、句末(方式+地点+时间)。
多个副词排列：方式→地点→时间(She sang beautifully in the hall yesterday)。
副词不可插在动词和宾语之间。enough放形容词后。

examples.en: She always works hard here.
examples.cn: 她总是在这里努力工作。

examples.en: They left quietly yesterday.

topics.title: 副词的构成
topics.summary: 多数形容词加ly，以y结尾变i加ly，以le结尾去e加y
topics.detail:
构成规则：一般+ly(slow→slowly)；辅音+y变i加ly(happy→happily)；以le去e加y(simple→simply)；以ic加ally(basic→basically)。
注意：有些词兼作形/副：fast, hard, early, late, high。
有些-ly词是形容词：friendly, lovely, lonely。

examples.en: He drives carefully.
She easily solved the problem.

topics.title: 不规则副词
topics.summary: good→well, fast→fast, hard→hard等无ly变化
topics.detail:
不加-ly的副词(形副同形)：fast, hard, early, late, high, long, far, straight, near。
形式相同意义不同：hard(努力)vs hardly(几乎不)；late(迟)vs lately(最近)；near(近)vs nearly(几乎)；high(高)vs highly(高度地)。

examples.en: She works hard.
He arrived late.

topics.title: 副词比较级最高级
topics.summary: 单音节加er/est，多音节用more/most
topics.detail:
单音节副词加-er/-est：fast→faster→fastest, hard→harder→hardest。
多音节用more/most：quickly→more quickly→most quickly。
不规则：well→better→best, badly→worse→worst。
比较级+than；最高级前the可省。

examples.en: She runs faster than him.
Who sings the best?

topics.title: too与enough
topics.summary: too表过度，enough表足够，位置不同
topics.detail:
too+形/副：too big, too fast。too...to do(太…而不能)：too tired to walk。
形/副+enough：good enough, old enough。enough+名词：enough money。
enough...to do(足够…可以)：strong enough to carry。

examples.en: This box is too heavy to carry.
She is old enough to drive.

topics.title: 介词in/on/at表时间
topics.summary: in表较长时段，on表具体某天，at表具体时刻
topics.detail:
in+较长时段：in January, in spring, in 2024, in the morning。
on+具体某天：on Monday, on July 4th, on a cold morning。
at+具体时刻：at 3 o'clock, at noon, at night, at Christmas。
on time(准时), in time(及时)。

examples.en: I was born in 2000.
The train leaves at 8.

topics.title: 介词in/on/at表地点
topics.summary: in表大空间内，on表表面，at表具体地点
topics.detail:
in+大空间/内部：in Beijing, in the room, in the box。
on+表面/楼层：on the table, on the wall, on the second floor。
at+具体地点：at the station, at school, at home, at 123 Main St。
in the wall(墙内)vs on the wall(墙面上)。

examples.en: She lives in Beijing.
The book is on the table.

topics.title: 介词by的用法
topics.summary: by表方式/被动/时间/交通，用法多样
topics.detail:
表交通：by bus, by car, by train(不加冠词)。
表被动执行者：written by Shakespeare。
表方式：by chance, by hand, by phone。
表时间'到…为止'：by Friday, by the end of the year。
by oneself=独自。by+doing=通过做…。

examples.en: She goes to work by subway.
You must finish by Friday.

topics.title: 介词with的用法
topics.summary: with表伴随/工具/拥有/方式
topics.detail:
表伴随：go with friends。
表工具：cut with a knife, write with a pen。
表拥有：a girl with long hair, a house with a garden。
表原因：shake with cold, red with anger。
with复合结构：with the door open, with him standing there。

examples.en: She cut the cake with a knife.
The girl with blue eyes is my sister.

topics.title: 介词through
topics.summary: through表穿过/经历/通过，强调从内部经过
topics.detail:
表空间穿过：walk through the forest, look through the window。
表方式'通过'：succeed through hard work, learn through practice。
表经历：go through difficulties。
表时间'整个期间'：through the night, Monday through Friday。
through(内部穿过)vs across(表面横过)。

examples.en: We walked through the forest.
She succeeded through hard work.

topics.title: 介词of
topics.summary: of表所属/构成/关于，使用最广的介词之一
topics.detail:
表所属：the capital of China, a friend of mine。
表材料：a ring of gold, a house of stone。
表原因：die of cancer, proud of you, tired of waiting。
表数量：a cup of tea, a lot of people, millions of stars。
of常替代's用于无生命名词所有格。

examples.en: The capital of France is Paris.
I am proud of you.

topics.title: 介词about
topics.summary: about表关于/大约/周围
topics.detail:
表话题：talk about sports, a book about history, worry about exams。
表大约：about 20 people, about three o'clock。
表周围：look about, wander about。
be about to do=即将做：The meeting is about to start。
How about...?=…怎么样？

examples.en: Let's talk about the plan.
There are about 50 students.

topics.title: 介词for
topics.summary: for表目的/原因/持续/交换/目的地
topics.detail:
表目的：study for the exam, a gift for you。
表原因：famous for, thank you for。
表持续：for three hours, for ten years。
表交换：exchange A for B。
表目的地：leave for New York。
表赞成：Are you for or against?
for+时段vs since+时间点。

examples.en: I bought a gift for you.
She has lived here for ten years.

topics.title: between与among
topics.summary: between用于两者之间，among用于三者以上
topics.detail:
between用于两者：between you and me, the distance between A and B。
也用于多个独立个体间：a treaty between three countries。
among用于三者以上'在…之中'：among the crowd, among the trees。
between强调两两关系，among强调群体中。

examples.en: The choice is between you and me.
She stood among the crowd.

topics.title: over与above
topics.summary: over表正上方/覆盖，above表高于不一定正上方
topics.detail:
over：正上方(a lamp over the table)；覆盖(put a blanket over him)；越过(jump over the wall)；超过(over 50 people)；期间(over the years)。
above：高于(The picture is above the sofa)；超过(above average, above zero)。
over强调垂直正上方，above只强调高于。

examples.en: A bridge goes over the river.
The temperature is above zero.

topics.title: under与below
topics.summary: under表正下方/被覆盖，below表低于不一定正下方
topics.detail:
under：正下方(the cat under the table)；被覆盖(under the blanket)；少于(under 18)；过程中(under construction)。
below：低于(sank below the horizon, below zero)；以下(sign below)。
under强调正下方，below只强调低于某水平。

examples.en: The cat is under the table.
The bridge is under construction.

topics.title: in与into
topics.summary: in表位置在某空间内，into表进入的动作方向
topics.detail:
in表静态位置'在…内'：in the room, in the box。
into表动态方向'进入'：go into the room, jump into the water。
into还表转变：turn water into ice, translate into Chinese。
in可作副词：come in。

examples.en: She is in the kitchen.
He jumped into the pool.

topics.title: to与toward(s)
topics.summary: to表方向/终点，toward表朝向不一定到达
topics.detail:
to：方向/目的地(go to school, fly to London)；接受者(give to him)；比较(prefer A to B)。
toward(s)：朝向(walk toward the door)；趋势(toward evening)；对于(attitude toward work)。
to强调到达，toward强调方向。toward(美)/towards(英)。

examples.en: She walked to the station.
He walked toward the door.

topics.title: 常见介词短语
topics.summary: in fact, on time, at last等固定介词短语搭配
topics.detail:
in短语：in fact, in time, in danger, in a hurry, in charge of, in general, in return, in vain, in addition。
on短语：on time, on duty, on purpose, on sale, on average, on business。
at短语：at first, at last, at least, at once, at present, at the same time。
by短语：by chance, by mistake, by hand, by the way, by far。

examples.en: In fact, I agree.
The meeting started on time.

topics.title: both...and
topics.summary: 连接两个并列成分，表'既…又…'，谓语用复数
topics.detail:
both...and连接对等成分：both名词/形容词/动词。
连接主语谓语用复数：Both Tom and Mary are students。
连接成分须结构对等。
both可单独用：Both of them came。

examples.en: She speaks both English and French.
Both Tom and Jerry are friends.

topics.title: either...or
topics.summary: 表选择，连接两个成分，谓语就近一致
topics.detail:
either...or表'要么…要么…'。连接主语时谓语就近一致。
Either you or he is wrong. (与he一致用is)
Either he or you are wrong. (与you一致用are)
否定形式：neither...nor。

examples.en: You can either stay or leave.
Either you or he is responsible.

topics.title: neither...nor
topics.summary: 表否定两者，谓语就近一致
topics.detail:
neither...nor表'既不…也不…'，否定两者。
连接主语谓语就近一致：Neither you nor he is wrong.
连接成分须结构对等。
neither可单独用：Neither of them is right。

examples.en: She neither smokes nor drinks.
Neither you nor he is wrong.

topics.title: not only...but also
topics.summary: 表'不但…而且'，连接对等成分
topics.detail:
not only...but also表'不但…而且…'，强调后者。
连接主语谓语就近一致。
倒装(强调时)：Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
also可省略：She is not only beautiful but intelligent.
两成分须结构对等。

examples.en: She not only sings but also dances.
Not only did he apologize, but he also paid.

topics.title: and/or/but基础连词
topics.summary: and表并列，or表选择，but表转折
topics.detail:
and：并列(Tom and Jerry)；顺序(washed and dried)；因果(Study hard, and you'll pass)。
or：选择(tea or coffee)；否则(Hurry up, or you'll be late)。
but：转折(rich but unhappy)；除外(everyone but me)。
and和but不可连用。

examples.en: I like apples and oranges.
Hurry up, or you'll be late.

topics.title: so与yet
topics.summary: so表因果'所以'，yet表转折'然而'
topics.detail:
so(所以)：It was late, so I went home.
so+adj+that(如此…以至于)：so tired that I fell asleep.
so that(以便)：I got up early so that I could catch the train.
yet(然而)：He is rich, yet unhappy.
yet也作副词'还'：not yet。

examples.en: It was raining, so I stayed home.
She is rich, yet unhappy.

topics.title: for与as
topics.summary: for表补充原因，as表因为/作为/当…时
topics.detail:
for(补充原因，不放句首)：He must be ill, for he looks pale.
as(当…时/因为/作为)：As I was walking, I saw him. / As it rained, we stayed. / She works as a nurse.
as...as(同级比较)：as tall as。
as if(仿佛)：He looks as if he were ill。

examples.en: He must be tired, for he worked all night.
examples.cn: 他一定累了，因为工作了一整夜。

examples.en: As I was leaving, the phone rang.

topics.title: 基础从属连词
topics.summary: when/because/if/although等引导从句
topics.detail:
时间：when, while, before, after, since, until, as soon as。
原因：because, since, as, now that。
条件：if, unless, as long as, in case。
让步：although, though, even though。
目的：so that, in order that。
结果：so...that, such...that。
although和but不同时用。

examples.en: When I arrived, he was sleeping.
Because it rained, we stayed home.

topics.title: 反身代词
topics.summary: myself/yourself/himself等表动作回到主语自身
topics.detail:
反身代词：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。
作宾语(动作回主语)：I hurt myself. / She taught herself English.
强调用法：I myself did it. / I saw it myself.
固定搭配：enjoy oneself(玩得开心), help oneself to(请自便), by oneself(独自), teach oneself(自学)。

examples.en: She taught herself English.
Help yourselves to some fruit.

topics.title: 相互代词
topics.summary: each other和one another表互相
topics.detail:
each other(两者间)：The two sisters love each other.
one another(三者以上)：The members help one another.
所有格：each other's books, one another's problems。
介词+相互代词：talk to each other, look at each other。
不作主语。

examples.en: The two sisters love each other.
They looked at each other in surprise.

topics.title: 关系代词基础
topics.summary: who/whom/whose/which/that引导定语从句
topics.detail:
who(人,主语)：The man who lives next door is a doctor.
whom(人,宾语,可省)：The man (whom) I met is a doctor.
whose(所属)：The girl whose hair is long is my friend.
which(物)：The book which is on the table is mine.
that(人/物,限制性从句)：The book that I bought.
非限制性从句不用that。

examples.en: The man who is talking is my father.
The book that I bought is interesting.

topics.title: 疑问代词
topics.summary: who/whom/whose/what/which用于提问
topics.detail:
who(谁,主语)：Who is that man?
whom(谁,宾语)：Whom did you meet? (口语常用Who)
whose(谁的)：Whose book is this?
what(什么)：What do you want?
which(哪个,有选择范围)：Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
who问身份，what问事物，which问选择。

examples.en: Who is the girl over there?
Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
examples.cn: 你更喜欢哪个，茶还是咖啡？

topics.title: 不定代词
topics.summary: someone/anything/nobody/everyone等表不确定指代
topics.detail:
some系列(肯定)：someone, something, somewhere。
any系列(否定/疑问/条件)：anyone, anything, anywhere。肯定句表'任何'。
no系列(否定)：no one/nobody, nothing, nowhere。
every系列：everyone/everybody, everything, everywhere。
不定代词作主语谓语单数。修饰词放其后：something important。

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the door.
Nobody knows the answer.

topics.title: 指示代词
topics.summary: this/that/these/those指示近处或远处
topics.detail:
this/these(近处)：This is my book. / These are hers.
that/those(远处)：That is her house. / Those were happy days.
打电话：This is John. / Is that Mary?
介绍：This is my friend Tom.
指上文：He was late. That's why he was angry。

examples.en: This is my new car.
Those were happy days.

topics.title: 物主代词
topics.summary: my/your/his与mine/yours/his，形容词性与名词性
topics.detail:
形容词性(后接名词)：my, your, his, her, its, our, their → my book。
名词性(单独使用)：mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs → This is mine.
名词性=形容词性+名词：This pen is mine = This is my pen.
of+名词性(双重所有格)：a friend of mine。

examples.en: This is my book and that is yours.
Our school is bigger than theirs.

topics.title: 人称代词
topics.summary: I/you/he/she/it/we/they主格与宾格
topics.detail:
主格(作主语)：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。
宾格(作宾语/表语)：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。
主格作主语(She is a teacher)；宾格作动词/介词宾语(I like her. Listen to me)。
并列主语礼貌顺序：你>他>她>我。

examples.en: She is my best friend.
I gave the book to him.

topics.title: it的基本用法
topics.summary: it指物/天气/时间/距离/形式主语/形式宾语
topics.detail:
指事物：Where is my book? — It is on the desk.
指天气/时间/距离：It is raining. / It is 8 o'clock. / It is two miles.
形式主语：It is important to learn English. / It takes me two hours.
形式宾语：I find it hard to get up early.
强调句：It was Tom who broke the window。

examples.en: It is a beautiful day.
It is important to learn English.

topics.title: one与ones替代
topics.summary: one替代可数单数，ones替代复数，避免重复
topics.detail:
one替代上文单数可数名词：I don't like this pen; I want a new one.
ones替代复数：These apples are bad; give me fresh ones.
the one特指单数，the ones特指复数。
前面有形容词：a red one, the big one。
不可数名词不用one替代。

examples.en: I don't like this shirt; show me another one.
examples.cn: 我不喜欢这件衬衫，给我看另一件。

examples.en: These cookies are good; I want more ones.
examples.cn: 这些饼干好，我还要一些。

topics.title: 冠词a/an
topics.summary: a用于辅音音素前，an用于元音音素前
topics.detail:
a+辅音音素：a book, a car, a university(ju:), a one-eyed man。
an+元音音素：an apple, an egg, an umbrella, an hour(h不发音), an honest man, an MBA。
表泛指'一个'：I have a pen.
表种类：A dog is loyal. = Dogs are loyal.
表'每一'：three times a day, sixty miles an hour。

examples.en: She is a university student.
I'll be there in an hour.

topics.title: 定冠词the
topics.summary: the表特指，用于双方共知或再次提到的人/物
topics.detail:
特指：Pass me the salt. / The man in blue is my teacher.
再次提到：I bought a book. The book is interesting.
独一无二：the sun, the moon, the earth。
序数词/最高级前：the first, the best。
the+形容词(表一类人)：the rich, the poor。
the+姓氏复数(全家)：the Smiths。
乐器前：play the piano。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
She plays the piano well.

topics.title: 零冠词
topics.summary: 不使用冠词的场合
topics.detail:
复数泛指：Dogs are loyal.
不可数泛指：Water is important.
专有名词：China, Beijing, John。
三餐/运动/学科：have breakfast, play football, study math。
固定搭配：at home, go to school, by bus, in bed。
go to school(去上学)vs go to the school(去学校办事)。

examples.en: Dogs are loyal animals.
She goes to school by bus.

topics.title: 冠词惯用搭配
topics.summary: 固定搭配中的冠词用法需整体记忆
topics.detail:
加the：in the morning, in the end, on the other hand, out of the question。
不加：at noon/night, at home/school, by bus/car, on foot, by chance, by heart, day and night, hand in hand。
对比：in front of(在…前面)vs in the front of(在…前部)；out of question(没问题)vs out of the question(不可能)。

examples.en: She goes to school by bus.
In the end, we succeeded.

topics.title: 地理名称冠词
topics.summary: 江河海洋加the，湖泊山峰国名一般不加the
topics.detail:
加the：江河(the Yangtze), 海洋(the Pacific), 群岛(the Philippines), 山脉(the Alps), 沙漠(the Sahara), 由普通名词组成的国家(the United States)。
不加the：湖泊(Lake Michigan), 单座山(Mount Tai), 国家(China), 城市(Beijing), 街道(Wall Street), 公园(Central Park)。

examples.en: The Yangtze is the longest river in China.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain.

topics.title: 抽象名词与物质名词冠词
topics.summary: 泛指不加，特指加the，种类加a/an
topics.detail:
泛指不加：Knowledge is power. / Water is essential.
特指加the：The water in this river is clean.
加a/an表种类/实例：a success(成功的事), a coffee(一杯咖啡), a heavy rain。
有描绘性形容词时可用a/an：a fine tea, a heavy snow。
a knowledge of English(英语知识)。

examples.en: Knowledge is more important than money.
The coffee in this shop is excellent.

topics.title: 基数词与序数词
topics.summary: 基数词表数量，序数词表顺序
topics.detail:
基数词：one, two, three...hundred, thousand, million。21-99用连字符：twenty-one。hundred前有数字不加s：three hundred。
序数词：first, second, third, fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth, twentieth。构成：一般加th；第一/二/三特殊；ty结尾变y为i加eth。
序数词前加the：the first floor。也可加a/an表'又一个'：a third time。

examples.en: There are thirty-one days in May.
She lives on the third floor.

topics.title: 分数表达
topics.summary: 分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于1分母加s
topics.detail:
1/3 = one third (a third)。1/2 = a half。1/4 = a quarter。
分子大于1分母加s：2/3 = two thirds, 3/4 = three quarters。
带分数：2 1/3 = two and one third。
分数+名词：one third of the students。
谓语与of后名词一致：Two thirds of the water is polluted. / Two thirds of students are boys。

examples.en: One third of the students are boys.
examples.cn: 三分之一的学生是男生。

examples.en: She ate two thirds of the cake.
examples.cn: 她吃了三分之二的蛋糕。

topics.title: 小数表达
topics.summary: 小数点读point，小数点前后分别读数字
topics.detail:
0.5 = zero point five / point five。
3.14 = three point one four。
0.25 = zero point two five。
小数+名词：3.5 meters = three point five meters。
小数点后数字逐个读：3.14159 = three point one four one five nine。
百分数：50% = fifty percent, 3.5% = three point five percent。

examples.en: The box weighs 2.5 kilograms.
The temperature is 36.5 degrees.

topics.title: 倍数表达
topics.summary: 倍数+as...as或倍数+比较级或倍数+the+名词
topics.detail:
结构1：倍数+as+原级+as → twice as big as(两倍大)。
结构2：倍数+比较级+than → three times bigger than(大三倍)。
结构3：倍数+the+名词+of → twice the size of(两倍大小)。
动词：double(翻番), triple(三倍)。
1倍=the same as。

examples.en: This room is twice as large as that one.
examples.cn: 这个房间是那个两倍大。

examples.en: The price has doubled in five years.

topics.title: 百分比表达
topics.summary: percent或%表示百分率，谓语与of后名词一致
topics.detail:
50% = fifty percent。100% = one hundred percent。
谓语与of后名词一致：50% of students are boys(复数). / 50% of water is clean(不可数)。
搭配：increase by 20%(增长20%)；increase to 50%(增长到50%)；20% off(打八折)。
3 out of 5 = 五分之三。

examples.en: Sixty percent of the students passed.
examples.cn: 百分之六十的学生通过了。

examples.en: Prices increased by 15% this year.

topics.title: 编号表达
topics.summary: 编号用名词+基数词或the+序数词+名词
topics.detail:
名词+基数词：Page 5, Room 101, Bus No. 5, World War II。
the+序数词+名词：the fifth page, the third lesson。
电话号码逐个读：555-8901 → five five five, eight nine oh one。
年份：1999 = nineteen ninety-nine; 2008 = two thousand and eight。
时间：7:30 = seven thirty / half past seven。

examples.en: Open your books to Page 15.
Take Bus No. 5 to the station.

topics.title: 日期和时间表达
topics.summary: 日期、时间、时刻的表达方式
topics.detail:
日期：May 4(th) / the fourth of May / May the fourth。
时间：7:00 = seven (o'clock); 7:30 = seven thirty / half past seven; 7:15 = seven fifteen / a quarter past seven; 7:45 = seven forty-five / a quarter to eight。
世纪年代：the 21st century, the 1990s (the nineties)。
时刻表：at 8 a.m., from 9 to 5。

examples.en: The meeting starts at 2:30 p.m.
She was born on May 4th, 2000.

topics.title: 一般现在时vs现在进行时
topics.summary: 一般现在表习惯，进行时表此时此刻正在发生
topics.detail:
一般现在时表经常性/习惯性/真理：She works here every day.
现在进行时表此时正在发生或现阶段暂时的动作：She is working now.
状态动词不用进行时：I know him(不说I am knowing him)。
always+进行时表抱怨：She is always complaining(她老是抱怨)。

examples.en: She usually drinks tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
examples.cn: 她通常喝茶，但今天在喝咖啡。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun.

topics.title: 现在完成时vs一般过去时
topics.summary: 完成时强调与现在联系，过去时强调过去发生
topics.detail:
现在完成时(have/has+done)：强调过去动作对现在的影响或结果，不与具体过去时间连用。I have lost my key(现在还没找到)。
一般过去时(V-ed)：强调过去某时发生的动作，常与具体过去时间连用。I lost my key yesterday(只说昨天丢了)。
标志词：完成时用already/just/yet/ever/never；过去时用yesterday/last week/ago/in 2020。

examples.en: I have lived here for ten years.
examples.cn: 我在这里住了十年。(现在还住)

examples.en: I lived here in 2010.
examples.cn: 2010年我住在这里。(现在不一定住)

topics.title: 一般过去vs过去进行
topics.summary: 过去时表完成，进行时表当时正在发生
topics.detail:
一般过去时：过去某时完成的动作或状态。I read a book last night.
过去进行时：过去某时正在进行的动作。I was reading at 8 p.m. last night.
常搭配使用：长动作(进行时)被短动作(过去时)打断。I was reading when the phone rang.
并列进行时：While I was cooking, he was watching TV.

examples.en: I was watching TV when she called.
I watched TV last night.

topics.title: 过去完成时vs一般过去时
topics.summary: 过去完成时表过去的过去，先于另一过去动作
topics.detail:
过去完成时(had+done)：表示在过去某时之前已完成的动作，即'过去的过去'。
When I arrived, the train had left.(火车先开走，我后到)
对比：When I arrived, the train left.(我到了之后火车才开)
标志词：by the time, before, after, when, by the end of。
常用于间接引语中转述过去的事。

examples.en: When I arrived, the train had left.
examples.cn: 我到时火车已经开走了。

examples.en: She had finished before I came.
examples.cn: 我来之前她已经完成了。

topics.title: will与be going to
topics.summary: will表即时决定/预测，be going to表计划/迹象
topics.detail:
will：临时决定(I'll answer the phone)；客观预测(It will rain tomorrow)；意愿(I'll help you)。
be going to：已计划(I'm going to visit Paris)；有迹象的预测(Look at the clouds; it's going to rain)。
区别：will侧重未来意愿或无迹象预测；be going to侧重已有计划或可见迹象。

examples.en: I'll answer the phone.
I'm going to study abroad next year.
examples.cn: 我明年要出国留学。(已计划)

topics.title: 现在完成时vs完成进行时
topics.summary: 完成时强调结果，完成进行时强调持续过程
topics.detail:
现在完成时(have+done)：强调动作已完成或结果。I have read the book(读完了)。
现在完成进行时(have been+Ving)：强调动作从过去持续到现在，可能继续。I have been reading for two hours(读了两小时，可能继续)。
状态动词只用完成时：I have known him for years(不说have been knowing)。
for+时段，since+时间点。

examples.en: I have read three chapters.
I have been reading for two hours.
examples.cn: 我已经读了两小时。(还在读)

topics.title: 状态动词不用进行时
topics.summary: know/like/understand等状态动词不用进行时
topics.detail:
状态动词表心理/情感/拥有/感知，一般不用进行时：
心理：know, understand, believe, think(认为), remember, forget。
情感：like, love, hate, want, need, prefer。
拥有：have, own, belong, possess。
感知：see, hear, smell, taste, feel。
其他：be, seem, appear, exist, consist。
注意：有些词既可状态又可动作，意义不同：
think about(思考,可用进行时)vs think(认为,不用)；have(拥有,不用)vs have lunch(吃,可用)。

examples.en: I know the answer.
I am thinking about the problem.

topics.title: 时态呼应规则
topics.summary: 主句和从句的时态需保持一致
topics.detail:
时态呼应规则：
1. 主句过去时，从句也用过去相关时态：He said he was tired. / He said he had finished.
2. 主句现在/将来时，从句可用任何所需时态：I know he is/was/will be here.
3. 客观真理从句用现在时：The teacher said the earth is round.
4. 时间/条件状语从句中用现在时表将来：I'll call when I arrive.
5. hope/wish后的从句按意义用时态。

examples.en: He said he would come.
I'll tell him when he arrives.

topics.title: 时间状语从句中的时态
topics.summary: 时间状语从句用现在时表将来(主将从现)
topics.detail:
时间/条件状语从句中，用一般现在时表将来：
I'll call you when I arrive.(不说will arrive)
I won't go out if it rains tomorrow.
As soon as he comes, we'll start.
Before you leave, please lock the door.
After he finishes his homework, he can play.
Until you return, I'll wait here.
注意：主句用将来时(will)，从句用现在时。
若强调完成，可用现在完成时：When I have finished, I'll tell you。

examples.en: I'll tell him when he comes back.
If it rains, we'll stay home.

topics.title: 条件句中的时态
topics.summary: 条件句分真实和非真实条件句，时态不同
topics.detail:
真实条件句(Type 1)：If+现在时, 主句will+V。
If it rains, I will stay home.
非真实条件句(Type 2)：If+过去时, 主句would+V。
If I were rich, I would travel.
虚拟条件句(Type 3)：If+过去完成时, 主句would have+done。
If I had known, I would have helped.
混合条件句：If+过去完成时, 主句would+V。
If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.

examples.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.
If I were you, I would go.

topics.title: 一般现在时表状态
topics.summary: 状态动词用一般现在时表当前状态
topics.detail:
状态动词用一般现在时描述现在的状态：
I know the answer. (不说am knowing)
She likes music. (不说is liking)
He owns a car.
This belongs to me.
The soup tastes delicious.
I see a bird.
注意：状态动词表持续状态而非动作，不用进行时。
但表动作意义时可用进行时：I am tasting the soup(正在尝)。

examples.en: I understand the question.
She loves chocolate.

topics.title: 现在进行时表暂时
topics.summary: 进行时可表现阶段暂时的动作或状态
topics.detail:
现在进行时表现阶段暂时的情况：
I'm living with my parents temporarily.
She's working at a cafe this summer.
We're studying French this semester.
always+进行时表抱怨/赞叹：He's always losing his keys.
You're always helping others.
注意：进行时表暂时性，一般现在时表长期性。

examples.en: I'm living in Beijing this year.
She's always losing her keys.

topics.title: 一般过去时与具体时间
topics.summary: 过去时强调过去某具体时间发生的动作
topics.detail:
一般过去时常与具体过去时间标志词搭配：
yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in 2020, when I was young, just now, at that time。
I saw him yesterday.
She graduated two years ago.
They moved here in 2018.
注意：不能与现在完成时的时间标志词混用：
×I have seen him yesterday. → I saw him yesterday.

examples.en: She visited Paris last summer.
I graduated three years ago.

topics.title: 现在完成时与不明确时间
topics.summary: 完成时不与具体过去时间连用，强调与现在的联系
topics.detail:
现在完成时不与具体过去时间(yesterday, last week, in 2020等)连用：
I have lost my keys(现在还没找到).
Have you ever been to Japan?
She has just left.
They have already finished.
I haven't done it yet.
与不明确时间搭配：ever, never, already, just, yet, before, recently, so far, up to now, in the past few years。

examples.en: I have visited Japan twice.
Have you ever eaten sushi?

topics.title: for与since的用法
topics.summary: for+时段，since+时间点，常与完成时搭配
topics.detail:
for + 时段(多久)：for two hours, for ten years, for ages。
since + 时间点(自从何时)：since 2010, since Monday, since I was born, since last month。
主句用现在完成时：I have lived here for ten years. / I have lived here since 2010.
过去完成时：I had waited for two hours before he came。
注意：for可省略：I've waited (for) two hours。

examples.en: She has studied English for five years.
He has worked here since 2018.

topics.title: ever与never
topics.summary: ever用于疑问表'曾经'，never表'从不'
topics.detail:
ever用于疑问句/条件句/否定句表'曾经/在任何时候'：
Have you ever been to Paris?
If you ever need help, call me.
I don't think he has ever lied。
never表'从不/从未'：I have never been to Paris.
already用于肯定：I've already done it.
yet用于否定/疑问：I haven't done it yet. / Have you done it yet?
just表'刚刚'：She has just left.

examples.en: Have you ever been to China?
I have never eaten snails.

topics.title: before/after与过去完成时
topics.summary: before/after可明确时间先后，可不强制用过去完成时
topics.detail:
before和after已表明时间先后，过去完成时非必须：
Before I left, I (had) locked the door.
After he (had) finished, he went home.
但强调'先于'时用过去完成时：
When I arrived, he had already left.
By the time I got there, the meeting had ended.
by the time常引导过去完成时。

examples.en: Before I left, I had locked the door.
By the time I arrived, he had gone.

topics.title: will表预测
topics.summary: will可对未来情况进行预测
topics.detail:
will用于对未来预测：
It will rain tomorrow.
You'll love this movie.
I think he will win.
搭配：I think/I believe/I'm sure + will。
will be able to(将能够), will have to(将必须)。
shall用于第一人称征求意见：Shall I open the window?
Shall we go now?

examples.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
You'll love this book.

topics.title: be going to表意图
topics.summary: be going to表已计划的打算或意图
topics.detail:
be going to表已经决定的计划/意图：
I'm going to study medicine.
They're going to get married.
What are you going to do this weekend?
有迹象的预测：Look at the clouds; it's going to rain.
be about to do(即将做)：The movie is about to start.
be to do(预定做)：The President is to visit China.

examples.en: I'm going to learn Spanish next year.
The movie is about to start.

topics.title: 过去进行时被打断
topics.summary: 过去进行时常被一般过去时打断
topics.detail:
过去进行时表正在进行的动作，被一般过去时的短动作打断：
I was reading when the phone rang.
While I was cooking, he came home.
As she was crossing the street, she saw an accident.
两个同时进行的动作都用进行时：
While I was cooking, he was watching TV.
注意：when/while可互换，但while更强调同时性。

examples.en: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

topics.title: 现在进行时表将来
topics.summary: 进行时可表已安排好的将来计划
topics.detail:
现在进行时可表已经安排好的将来计划：
I'm meeting Tom tomorrow.
She's flying to London next week.
We're having a party on Saturday.
常与将来时间搭配：tomorrow, next week, this weekend。
适用于：go, come, leave, arrive, meet, see, have等动词。
区别：be going to表意图；进行时表已安排好的具体计划。

examples.en: I'm meeting the boss at 3 p.m.
She's leaving for Paris tomorrow.

topics.title: 一般现在时表将来
topics.summary: 时刻表/日程表中用一般现在时表将来
topics.detail:
按时间表/日程表发生的将来事件用一般现在时：
The train leaves at 8 a.m. tomorrow.
The flight takes off at 6 p.m.
The meeting starts at 3 o'clock.
适用于：交通时刻表、电影/演出时间、会议日程、节日。
注意：这是固定的计划安排，不因个人意愿改变。

examples.en: The train leaves at 8 a.m. tomorrow.
The movie starts at 7 p.m.

topics.title: 间接引语中的时态变化
topics.summary: 转述他人话语时，时态需相应变化
topics.detail:
间接引语中时态往过去推一级：
一般现在→一般过去：He said he was tired.
现在进行→过去进行：She said she was reading.
现在完成→过去完成：He said he had finished.
一般过去→过去完成：She said she had seen it.
will→would：He said he would come.
can→could, may→might, must→had to。
注意：客观真理不变：He said the earth is round.
今天转述也可不变时态：He said he is busy.

examples.en: He said he was tired.
She said she would call me.

topics.title: 时态一致性
topics.summary: 段落中时态应保持一致避免混乱
topics.detail:
写作中时态应保持一致：
叙述过去事件统一用过去时：Yesterday I went to the park. I saw many people. They were enjoying the sunshine.
描述习惯/事实统一用现在时：She gets up at six. She exercises every morning.
避免随意切换时态：×I went to school and see my friend. → I went to school and saw my friend.
合理切换：描述不同时间的动作可以换时态。

examples.en: Yesterday I went to the park and saw many people.
examples.cn: 昨天我去公园看到很多人。

examples.en: She gets up early every day.

topics.title: 被动语态总则
topics.summary: 被动语态构成be+过去分词，强调动作承受者
topics.detail:
被动语态基本构成：be + 过去分词。
各时态被动：
am/is/are done(一般现在); was/were done(一般过去); will be done(将来); am/is/are being done(进行); have/has been done(完成); had been done(过去完成)。
情态被动：can/must/should + be done。
主动转被动：宾语→主语，动词→be+done，主语→by宾语。
只有及物动词有被动。不及物动词(happen, arrive, occur)无被动。

examples.en: English is spoken all over the world.
The house was built in 1990.

topics.title: 主动转被动规则
topics.summary: 主动句宾语变主语，动词变被动，主语变by宾语
topics.detail:
主动转被动步骤：
1. 主动句的宾语变为被动句的主语。
2. 主动句的谓语动词变为be+过去分词。
3. 主动句的主语变为by短语(可省略)。
例：They built the house. → The house was built by them.
注意：
- 双宾语动词有两个被动式：He gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
- 含宾补的被动：They elected him president. → He was elected president.
- 短语动词被动不可拆开：They put off the meeting. → The meeting was put off.

examples.en: The cake was eaten by the boy.
She was given a present.

topics.title: 被动语态中by的用法
topics.summary: by引出动作执行者，但常可省略
topics.detail:
by短语引出动作执行者：
The book was written by Shakespeare.
The window was broken by a stone.
省略by的情况：
1. 不知执行者：My car was stolen.
2. 执行者不重要：The bridge was built in 1990.
3. 泛指人们：English is spoken in Canada.
4. 明显的执行者：He was arrested.
注意：with也可引出工具(非执行者)：He was killed with a knife. (knife是工具)

examples.en: The painting was painted by Picasso.
My bike was stolen last night.
examples.cn: 我的自行车昨晚被偷了。

topics.title: 双宾语被动
topics.summary: give/send等双宾语动词的被动有两种形式
topics.detail:
双宾语动词(give, send, show, tell, lend, offer, teach, pass, bring, hand)有两个被动形式：
1. 间接宾语作主语：I was given a book. / She was offered a job.
2. 直接宾语作主语(需加to/for)：A book was given to me. / A job was offered to her.
常用第1种形式。
注意：make/buy/get等用for不用to：A cake was made for her. (不说to her)

examples.en: She was given a present.
A present was given to her.

topics.title: 名词性从句概述
topics.summary: that/if/whether/wh-引导的从句在句中作名词成分
topics.detail:
名词性从句在句中起名词作用，可作主语、宾语、表语、同位语。
引导词：that(无词义,引导陈述), if/whether(是否), wh-词(what/who/which/when/where/why/how)。
语序：陈述语序(主语+谓语)，不用疑问语序。
时态呼应：主句过去时，从句也用过去相关时态。
that在宾语从句中常可省略。

examples.en: What he said is true.
I don't know if he will come.

topics.title: that引导主语从句
topics.summary: that从句作主语，that不可省略
topics.detail:
that引导主语从句时that不可省略：
That she passed the exam is good news.
That he is honest is true.
常用it作形式主语，that从句后移：
It is good news that she passed the exam.
It is true that he is honest.
It is important that we study hard.
It is a pity that he failed.

examples.en: That she passed the exam is good news.
examples.cn: 她通过了考试是好消息。

examples.en: It is important that we study hard.

topics.title: that引导宾语从句
topics.summary: that引导宾语从句，that常可省略
topics.detail:
that引导宾语从句时that常可省略：
I think (that) he is right.
She said (that) she was tired.
He told me (that) he would come.
注意：
- 两个that从句并列时第一个that可省，第二个不可省。
- 介词后不用that从句(用it替代)：I'm sure of it that he will come.
- 动词后跟多个宾语从句时只用一个that引导。

examples.en: I think that he is right.
She said she was tired.

topics.title: that引导表语从句
topics.summary: that从句作表语，说明主语的内容
topics.detail:
that引导表语从句：
The truth is that he lied.
My opinion is that we should go.
The problem is that we don't have enough money.
The reason is that he was ill.
注意：because也可引导表语从句：The reason is because he was ill.(较口语) / The reason is that he was ill.(更规范)

examples.en: The truth is that he lied.
The problem is that we have no money.

topics.title: that引导同位语从句
topics.summary: that从句解释名词内容，that不省略
topics.detail:
同位语从句解释名词(fact/news/idea/hope/truth/reason/suggestion等)的具体内容：
The news that he won the prize is exciting.
The fact that the earth is round is true.
I have no idea that he was coming.
注意：that在同位语从句中不充当成分，只起连接作用，不可省略。
区别定语从句：that在同位语从句中不作成分，在定语从句中作主/宾语。

examples.en: The news that he won the prize is exciting.
examples.cn: 他获奖的消息令人兴奋。

examples.en: The fact that the earth is round is true.
examples.cn: 地球是圆的这一事实是真的。

topics.title: if与whether引导从句
topics.summary: if/whether表'是否'，whether更正式可接or not
topics.detail:
if和whether引导宾语从句表'是否'：
I don't know if/whether he will come.
whether更正式，可用于主语从句/表语从句：
Whether he will come is uncertain.
whether可接or not：I don't know whether he will come or not.
whether可接不定式：I don't know whether to go.
注意：if引导从句不放句首(主语从句不用if)，whether可以。
介词后只用whether：It depends on whether he comes。

examples.en: I don't know if he will come.
Whether he will come is uncertain.

topics.title: wh-引导名词性从句
topics.summary: what/who/which/when/where/why/how引导从句
topics.detail:
wh-词引导名词性从句，用陈述语序：
What he said surprised me.(主语从句)
I don't know where he lives.(宾语从句)
The question is how we can solve it.(表语从句)
Tell me when you will arrive.
I wonder why he was late.
注意：从句用陈述语序，不用疑问语序：
×I don't know where is he. → I don't know where he is.

examples.en: What he said surprised me.
I don't know where he lives.

topics.title: what/how引导感叹从句
topics.summary: what(a)+adj+n或how+adj/adv构成感叹
topics.detail:
感叹句结构：
What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语!
What a beautiful day it is!
What delicious food you cooked!
How + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语!
How beautiful the flower is!
How fast he runs!
注意：what修饰名词，how修饰形容词/副词。
可省略主语和谓语：What a day! / How beautiful!

examples.en: What a beautiful day it is!
How fast he runs!

topics.title: it作形式主语的从句
topics.summary: 用it替代that/wh从句作形式主语
topics.detail:
it作形式主语，真正主语在后：
It is important that we study hard.
It is said that he is rich.
It is a pity that she failed.
It seems that he is right.
It happened that I was there.
It is reported that the situation is improving.
常用句型：It is + adj/名词 + that从句。
It takes + 时间 + to do.

examples.en: It is important that we study hard.
It is said that he is rich.

topics.title: 名词性从句的语序
topics.summary: 名词性从句用陈述语序，不用疑问语序
topics.detail:
名词性从句必须用陈述语序(主语+谓语)：
正确：I don't know where he lives.
错误：I don't know where does he live.
正确：Can you tell me what time it is?
错误：Can you tell me what time is it?
正确：I wonder why he was late.
错误：I wonder why was he late?
注意：wh-词在从句中充当成分(主/宾/表/状)，从句剩余部分按陈述语序排列。

examples.en: Can you tell me where he lives?
I don't know what he wants.

topics.title: 名词性从句的时态呼应
topics.summary: 主句过去时从句也用过去相关时态
topics.detail:
时态呼应规则：
1. 主句现在/将来时，从句按实际情况用时态：I know he is/was/will be here.
2. 主句过去时，从句用过去相关时态：He said he was tired. / He said he had finished.
3. 客观真理不变：The teacher said the earth is round.
4. 主句过去时但从句表将来也可用would：He said he would come.
注意：could/would/might/should不受此限制。

examples.en: He said he was tired.
I know he will come tomorrow.

topics.title: 名词性从句常见句型
topics.summary: 名词性从句的常见固定句型
topics.detail:
常见句型：
1. That is why...(那就是为什么)：That is why he was late.
2. The reason is that...(原因是)：The reason is that he was ill.
3. It means that...(意味着)：It means that we have to start over.
4. The fact is that...(事实是)：The fact is that we can't afford it.
5. There is no doubt that...(毫无疑问)：There is no doubt that he is honest.
6. It turns out that...(结果是)：It turns out that he was right.
7. Chances are that...(可能)：Chances are that it will rain。

examples.en: That is why he was late.
There is no doubt that he is honest.

topics.title: 名词性从句主谓一致
topics.summary: 名词性从句作主语时谓语用单数
topics.detail:
名词性从句作主语时，谓语动词用单数：
What he said is true.(不说are)
That she passed the exam is good news.
Whether he will come is uncertain.
What we need is more time.
注意：what引导的主语从句，谓语可随表语变化：
What we need are more books.(表语是books复数)
What he gave me was a book.(表语是book单数)

examples.en: What he said is true.
What we need is more time.
examples.cn: 我们需要的是更多时间。

topics.title: 名词性从句的简化
topics.summary: 名词性从句可简化为不定式或动名词
topics.detail:
名词性从句的简化：
1. 宾语从句→不定式：I don't know what I should do. → I don't know what to do.
2. 主语从句→不定式：When we should start is unclear. → When to start is unclear.
3. whether从句→whether to do：I don't know whether I should go. → I don't know whether to go.
4. that从句→动名词(表建议/要求)：I suggest that we leave now. → I suggest leaving now.
注意：不是所有从句都能简化。

examples.en: I don't know what to do.
I don't know whether to go.

topics.title: 名词性从句特殊用法
topics.summary: 名词性从句的特殊情况和注意事项
topics.detail:
特殊用法：
1. that与what区别：that无词义不充当成分，what有词义充当成分。
  I think that he is right.(that不充当成分) vs I know what he wants.(what作宾语)
2. that从句不能作介词宾语：I'm interested in what he said.(不用that)
3. doubt后用if/whether，not doubt后用that：I doubt if he will come. / I don't doubt that he will come.
4. 同位语从句vs定语从句：that在同位语从句不充当成分，在定语从句充当成分。

examples.en: I'm interested in what he said.
I doubt if he will come.

topics.title: 定语从句概述
topics.summary: 关系代词/副词引导定语从句修饰先行词
topics.detail:
定语从句修饰名词(先行词)，由关系词引导。
关系代词：who(人,主), whom(人,宾), whose(所属), which(物), that(人/物)。
关系副词：when(时间), where(地点), why(原因)。
限制性定语从句：无逗号，不可省略，影响句意。
非限制性定语从句：有逗号，可省略，补充说明。
关系词在从句中充当成分(主/宾/定/状)。

examples.en: The man who is talking is my father.
examples.cn: 正在说话的人是我父亲。

examples.en: The book that I bought is interesting.

topics.title: 限制性定语从句
topics.summary: 无逗号隔开，不可省略，限定先行词范围
topics.detail:
限制性定语从句紧跟先行词，无逗号，限定先行词的范围。
The man who lives next door is a doctor.(限定是哪个man)
The book that I bought is interesting.(限定是哪本书)
可用that替代who/which。
关系代词作宾语可省略：The book (that) I bought is interesting.
先行词为物用that/which；为人用that/who。
被最高级/序数词/the only修饰时常用that。

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The book that I bought is interesting.

topics.title: 非限制性定语从句
topics.summary: 有逗号隔开，可省略，补充说明先行词
topics.detail:
非限制性定语从句用逗号与先行词隔开，补充说明，可省略不影响句意。
My father, who is a doctor, works hard.
The book, which I bought yesterday, is interesting.
注意：
- 不用that，用who/which。
- 关系代词不可省略。
- 可修饰整个句子：He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
- which可指代前文整句内容。

examples.en: My father, who is a doctor, works hard.
examples.cn: 我父亲是医生，工作很努力。

examples.en: He passed the exam, which made us happy.
examples.cn: 他通过了考试，这让我们很高兴。

topics.title: 关系代词who/whom
topics.summary: who作主语，whom作宾语，修饰人
topics.detail:
who(主格)：先行词为人，在从句中作主语。
The man who is standing there is my teacher.
whom(宾格)：在从句中作宾语，口语可省或用who替代。
The man (whom) I met yesterday is a doctor.
who/whom在限制性从句中可省略(作宾语时)。
whom在非限制性从句或介词后不省：The man to whom I spoke is a doctor.
口语常用who替代whom。

examples.en: The man who is standing there is my teacher.
examples.cn: 站在那里的人是我老师。

examples.en: The man whom I met is a doctor.
examples.cn: 我遇到的那个人是医生。

topics.title: 关系代词which
topics.summary: which修饰物，在从句中作主语或宾语
topics.detail:
which修饰物(先行词为物)，作主语或宾语。
The book which is on the table is mine.(主语)
The book (which) I bought is interesting.(宾语,可省)
非限制性从句中which可指代整个句子：
He failed the exam, which disappointed his parents.
which在非限制性从句中不可省略，也不用that。
介词+which：The house in which I live is old. = The house which I live in is old.

examples.en: The book which is on the table is mine.
He failed, which disappointed us.
examples.cn: 他失败了，这让我们失望。

topics.title: 关系代词that
topics.summary: that可修饰人或物，只用于限制性从句
topics.detail:
that可修饰人或物，只用于限制性定语从句。
The man that lives next door is a doctor.
The book that I bought is interesting.
必须用that的情况：
1. 先行词被最高级修饰：the best book that I've ever read。
2. 先行词被序数词修饰：the first thing that he did。
3. 先行词被the only/the very/just修饰：the only person that knows。
4. 先行词既有人又有物：the man and his dog that...。
5. 在疑问词who/which开头的句中：Who that knows him would say so?
不用that：非限制性从句；介词后。

examples.en: This is the best book that I've ever read.
examples.cn: 这是我读过的最好的书。

examples.en: He is the only person that knows the truth.
examples.cn: 他是唯一知道真相的人。

topics.title: 关系代词whose
topics.summary: whose表所属关系，可修饰人或物
topics.detail:
whose表所属关系，在从句中作定语。
修饰人：The girl whose father is a teacher is my friend.
修饰物：The book whose cover is red is mine. = The book the cover of which is red is mine.
whose既可修饰人也可修饰物。
注意：whose + 名词 = the + 名词 + of which/whom。
The girl whose hair is long = The girl the hair of whom is long. (较正式)
whose不可省略。

examples.en: The girl whose father is a teacher is my friend.
examples.cn: 父亲是老师的那个女孩是我朋友。

examples.en: The book whose cover is red is mine.
examples.cn: 封面是红色的那本书是我的。

topics.title: 关系副词when
topics.summary: when引导定语从句修饰时间名词
topics.detail:
when = 介词+which，修饰表示时间的先行词。
I remember the day when I first met her. = on which
That was the year when he was born. = in which
Do you know the time when the meeting starts?
注意：when在从句中作时间状语，不作主/宾语。
when可省略(限制性从句)：I'll never forget the day (when) we met.

examples.en: I remember the day when I first met her.
examples.cn: 我记得第一次见她的那天。

examples.en: That was the year when he was born.

topics.title: 关系副词where
topics.summary: where引导定语从句修饰地点名词
topics.detail:
where = 介词+which，修饰表示地点的先行词。
This is the house where I grew up. = in which
The city where she lives is beautiful.
This is the school where I studied.
注意：where在从句中作地点状语。
where可省略(限制性从句)：This is the place (where) we met.
区别：where从句vs状语从句：This is the place where we met.(定语,修饰place) vs Where there is a will, there is a way.(状语)

examples.en: This is the house where I grew up.
The city where she lives is beautiful.

topics.title: 关系副词why
topics.summary: why引导定语从句修饰reason
topics.detail:
why = for which，修饰先行词reason。
That is the reason why he was late. = for which
I don't know the reason why she cried.
This is the reason why we must leave.
注意：why在从句中作原因状语。
why可省略：That is the reason (why) he was late.
reason后可接that从句(同位语从句)：The reason that he was late is that he missed the bus.

examples.en: That is the reason why he was late.
I don't know the reason why she cried.

topics.title: 介词+关系代词
topics.summary: 介词+which/whom结构，正式用法
topics.detail:
介词+which(物)/whom(人)是正式用法。
The house in which I live is old. = which I live in
The man to whom I spoke is a doctor. = who I spoke to
介词的选择取决于从句中的搭配：
live in the house → in which I live
speak to the man → to whom I spoke
depend on it → on which it depends
注意：介词+that是错误的：×The house in that I live。

examples.en: The house in which I live is old.
The man to whom I spoke is a doctor.
examples.cn: 我跟他说话的那个人是医生。

topics.title: 关系代词的省略
topics.summary: 作宾语的关系代词在限制性从句中可省略
topics.detail:
关系代词在限制性定语从句中作宾语时可省略：
The book (that/which) I bought is interesting.
The man (who/whom) I met is a doctor.
This is the house (that/which) I bought.
不可省略的情况：
1. 作主语：The man who lives next door is a doctor. (who不可省)
2. 非限制性从句：My father, who is a doctor, works hard. (who不可省)
3. 介词后：The man to whom I spoke. (whom不可省)
4. whose不可省。

examples.en: The book I bought is interesting.
The man I met is a doctor.

topics.title: that与which的区别
topics.summary: 限制性从句that可替代which，非限制性不用that
topics.detail:
that与which的区别：
1. 限制性从句中，that可替代which(物)：The book that/which I bought.
2. 非限制性从句(有逗号)只能用which：My book, which is new, is interesting.
3. 介词后只用which：The house in which I live. (不用that)
4. 必须用that：先行词被最高级/序数词/the only修饰时。
5. 必须用which：非限制性从句；指代整个句子。
6. that可修饰人或物；which只修饰物。

examples.en: The book that I bought is new.
My book, which is new, is interesting.

topics.title: 定语从句的简化
topics.summary: 定语从句可简化为分词短语或介词短语
topics.detail:
定语从句的简化：
1. 简化为现在分词(主动)：The man who is standing there → The man standing there.
2. 简化为过去分词(被动)：The book that was written by him → The book written by him.
3. 简化为不定式(将to do)：The next train that will arrive → The next train to arrive.
4. 简化为形容词：A book that is interesting → An interesting book.
注意：进行时态的从句简化为现在分词；被动语态简化为过去分词；将来时简化为不定式。

examples.en: The man standing there is my teacher.
examples.cn: 站在那里的人是我老师。

examples.en: The book written by him is popular.

topics.title: 关系代词as
topics.summary: as引导定语从句，可放句首，表'正如'
topics.detail:
as引导定语从句，表'正如/像'，可放主句前或后。
As we all know, the earth is round.
He is from Australia, as is evident from his accent.
The same...as：the same book as mine(和我的同一本书)。
such...as：such books as are on the shelf(书架上的那些书)。
注意：as引导非限制性从句可放句首，which不可。
常见：as is known to all, as has been mentioned, as expected。

examples.en: As we all know, the earth is round.
He is from Australia, as is evident from his accent.
examples.cn: 他是澳洲人，从口音就听得出来。

topics.title: 关系代词but/what
topics.summary: but作关系代词表否定意义，what引导无先行词从句
topics.detail:
but作关系代词(否定意义)：
There is no one but knows him. = who doesn't know him.
(没有人不认识他)
There is no rule but has exceptions.
what引导名词性关系从句(无先行词)：
What you said is true. = The thing that you said is true.
I don't understand what he means. = the thing that he means.
注意：what不能引导定语从句(因为没有先行词)。

examples.en: There is no one but knows him.
What you said is true.

topics.title: 定语从句特殊用法
topics.summary: 定语从句的特殊情况和注意事项
topics.detail:
特殊用法：
1. 关系代词作宾语可省略(限制性从句)：The book I bought is new.
2. 介词+关系代词：The house in which I live is old.
3. whose+名词=of which/whom+名词：The book whose cover is red = the cover of which is red.
4. 关系词指代整个句子(非限制性)：He failed, which made us sad.
5. 分隔定语从句：The man is here who called you yesterday.
6. 定语从句vs同位语从句：The news that he won (同位语,that不充当成分) vs The news that he told me (定语,that作宾语)。

examples.en: He failed, which made us sad.
examples.cn: 他失败了，这让我们难过。

examples.en: The news that he won is exciting.
examples.cn: 他获胜的消息令人兴奋。

topics.title: 时间状语从句as soon as
topics.summary: as soon as表'一…就'，引导时间状语从句
topics.detail:
as soon as引导时间状语从句，表'一…就'：
As soon as I arrived, I called him.
I'll tell him as soon as he comes.
类似结构：
the moment/minute/instant + 从句 = 一…就。
The moment I saw her, I knew she was the one.
Hardly...when / No sooner...than(倒装)：
No sooner had I arrived than the phone rang.
Hardly had I sat down when the bell rang.

examples.en: As soon as I arrived, I called him.
I'll tell him as soon as he comes.

topics.title: 时间状语从句once
topics.summary: once表'一旦'，引导时间/条件状语从句
topics.detail:
once引导从句，表'一旦'，兼有时间和条件意义：
Once you start, you can't stop.
Once he arrives, we'll begin.
Once you understand the rule, it's easy.
注意：once引导的从句用现在时表将来：Once he comes, we'll start.
类似：as long as(只要), whenever(每当), now that(既然)。

examples.en: Once you start, you can't stop.
Once he arrives, we'll begin.

topics.title: 原因状语从句since/as
topics.summary: since/as表原因，语气比because弱
topics.detail:
since/as引导原因状语从句，语气比because弱。
since(既然)：Since you are here, let's start.
as(因为)：As it was raining, we stayed home.
区别：
- because：回答why提问，语气最强，可放主句后。
- since/as：已知原因，语气弱，常放句首。
- for：补充原因，不放句首，语气最弱。
now that(既然)：Now that you're here, help me.

examples.en: Since you are here, let's start.
examples.cn: 既然你来了，我们开始吧。

examples.en: As it was raining, we stayed home.

topics.title: 让步状语从句even if/even though
topics.summary: even if/though表'即使'，引导让步从句
topics.detail:
even if和even though引导让步状语从句，表'即使/尽管'：
Even if it rains, I'll go out.
Even though he was tired, he kept working.
区别：
- even if：假设性让步(可能不发生)：Even if it rains tomorrow, I'll go.
- even though：事实性让步(已发生)：Even though it was raining, he went out.
类似：though, although, while(虽然)。

examples.en: Even if it rains, I'll go out.
Even though he was tired, he kept working.

topics.title: 让步状语从句while
topics.summary: while可表'虽然/尽管'，引导让步从句
topics.detail:
while引导让步从句，表'虽然/尽管'：
While I understand your point, I disagree.
While he is clever, he is lazy.
注意：while有多种意义：
1. 当…时(时间)：While I was reading, he called.
2. 虽然/尽管(让步)：While I agree, I have concerns.
3. 然而/而(对比)：I like tea, while he likes coffee.
根据语境判断意义。

examples.en: While I understand your point, I disagree.
examples.cn: 虽然我理解你的观点，但我不同意。

examples.en: I like tea, while he likes coffee.
examples.cn: 我喜欢茶，而他喜欢咖啡。

topics.title: 条件状语从句as long as
topics.summary: as long as/provided that表'只要'
topics.detail:
as long as和provided/providing that引导条件从句，表'只要'：
As long as you try, you can succeed.
You can borrow it provided that you return it tomorrow.
类似结构：
on condition that(条件是)
in case(万一)
unless(除非) = if...not
注意：条件从句用现在时表将来：As long as you come, I'll wait.

examples.en: As long as you try, you can succeed.
You can borrow it provided that you return it.
examples.cn: 你可以借，前提是还回来。

topics.title: 条件状语从句in case
topics.summary: in case表'万一/以防'，引导条件从句
topics.detail:
in case引导从句，表'万一/以防'：
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll write it down in case I forget.
注意：in case从句中常用should(较正式)或现在时/过去时：
In case it should rain, take an umbrella.
in case of + 名词：In case of fire, call 119.
区别：in case(以防万一) vs if(如果)。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll write it down in case I forget.

topics.title: 目的状语从句in order that
topics.summary: in order that/so that表目的，从句含can/will
topics.detail:
in order that和so that引导目的状语从句：
I got up early so that I could catch the train.
He spoke loudly in order that everyone could hear.
从句中通常含can/could/will/would/may/might等情态动词。
否定形式：so that...won't/in order that...may not。
简化为不定式：so as to do / in order to do。
I got up early in order to catch the train.

examples.en: I got up early so that I could catch the train.
He spoke loudly so everyone could hear.
examples.cn: 他大声说以便大家都能听到。

topics.title: 结果状语从句such...that
topics.summary: such+(a/an)+adj+n+that表'如此…以至于'
topics.detail:
such...that引导结果状语从句：
such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that从句。
It was such a hot day that we stayed home.
He is such a clever boy that everyone likes him.
与so...that的区别：
so + 形容词/副词 + that：so hot that we stayed home.
such + 名词短语 + that：such a hot day that...
so + 形容词 + a/an + 名词：so hot a day that...(正式)
such that(结果是)：His anger was such that he couldn't speak。

examples.en: It was such a hot day that we stayed home.
examples.cn: 天气太热了，我们待在家。

examples.en: He is such a clever boy that everyone likes him.
examples.cn: 他如此聪明，大家都喜欢他。

topics.title: 方式状语从句as if/though
topics.summary: as if/though表'仿佛/好像'，可接虚拟语气
topics.detail:
as if和as though引导方式状语从句，表'仿佛/好像'：
He looks as if he were ill.(虚拟,实际上没病)
He looks as if he is ill.(直陈,可能真病了)
It seems as though it will rain.
注意：
- 表与现在事实相反用过去时(were)：He talks as if he knew everything.
- 表与过去事实相反用过去完成时：He looks as if he had seen a ghost.
- as if后可接不定式：He opened his mouth as if to speak。

examples.en: He looks as if he were ill.
She talks as if she knew everything.
examples.cn: 她说话好像什么都知道。

topics.title: 比较状语从句as...as
topics.summary: as...as表同级比较，not as/so...as表不如
topics.detail:
as...as引导比较状语从句：
He runs as fast as his brother does.
She is as tall as her mother.
否定形式：not as/so...as。
He doesn't run as fast as his brother.
倍数：twice as...as, three times as...as。
This room is twice as big as that one.
注意：第一个as后接形容词/副词原级。

examples.en: He runs as fast as his brother.
This room is twice as big as that one.
examples.cn: 这个房间是那个两倍大。

topics.title: 让步状语从句no matter
topics.summary: no matter what/who/how表'无论…'
topics.detail:
no matter + wh-词引导让步从句，表'无论…'：
No matter what happens, I'll support you.
No matter how hard he tried, he failed.
No matter where you go, I'll follow.
= whatever/whoever/however/wherever：
Whatever happens, I'll support you.
However hard he tried, he failed.
注意：no matter what侧重让步(无论什么)；whatever可引导名词性从句。

examples.en: No matter what happens, I'll support you.
examples.cn: 无论发生什么，我都支持你。

examples.en: However hard he tried, he failed.
examples.cn: 无论多努力，他都失败了。

topics.title: 直接引语与间接引语概述
topics.summary: 直接引语加引号原话转述，间接引语用自己的话转述
topics.detail:
直接引语：原话加引号。She said, 'I am tired.'
间接引语：用自己的话转述。She said that she was tired.
转换要点：
1. 去引号加that(陈述句)。
2. 人称变化：I→he/she, my→his/her。
3. 时态变化：往过去推一级。
4. 时间/地点词变化：now→then, today→that day, here→there。
5. 指示词变化：this→that, these→those。
6. 疑问句语序变陈述语序。

examples.en: She said, 'I am tired.'
She said that she was tired.

topics.title: 间接引语陈述句
topics.summary: 直接陈述句转间接引语需变人称、时态、时间词
topics.detail:
陈述句的转换：
1. 人称变化：I→he/she, we→they, my→his/her。
   He said, 'I lost my key.' → He said that he had lost his key.
2. 时态变化(主句过去时)：
   一般现在→一般过去：am→was, work→worked。
   现在进行→过去进行：am reading→was reading。
   现在完成→过去完成：have done→had done。
   一般过去→过去完成：did→had done。
   will→would, can→could, may→might, must→had to。

examples.en: He said, 'I am tired.'
He said that he was tired.

topics.title: 间接引语疑问句
topics.summary: 疑问句转间接引语用if/whether或wh-词，语序变陈述
topics.detail:
疑问句的转换：
1. 一般疑问句→if/whether：
   He asked, 'Are you ready?' → He asked if/whether I was ready.
2. 特殊疑问句→wh-词：
   She asked, 'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived.
3. 语序变陈述语序(主语+谓语)：
   ×She asked where did I live. → She asked where I lived.
4. 疑问词作主语时语序不变：
   He asked, 'Who is there?' → He asked who was there.
5. 时态/人称变化同陈述句。

examples.en: He asked, 'Do you like tea?'
He asked if I liked tea.

topics.title: 间接引语祈使句
topics.summary: 祈使句转间接引语用tell/ask sb to do结构
topics.detail:
祈使句的转换：
1. 肯定祈使句→to do：
   He said, 'Open the door.' → He told me to open the door.
   She said, 'Please sit down.' → She asked me to sit down.
2. 否定祈使句→not to do：
   He said, 'Don't smoke.' → He told me not to smoke.
3. 引导动词变化：
   tell sb to do(告诉), ask sb to do(请), order sb to do(命令), advise sb to do(建议), warn sb to do(警告)。
4. Let's→suggest doing/suggest that：
   He said, 'Let's go.' → He suggested going. / He suggested that we go.

examples.en: He told me to open the door.
She asked me not to smoke.

topics.title: 间接引语时间地点词变化
topics.summary: now→then, today→that day, here→there等变化
topics.detail:
时间/地点/指示词的变化：
now→then, today→that day, tonight→that night。
yesterday→the day before/the previous day。
tomorrow→the next day/the following day。
this week→that week, last week→the week before。
ago→before, here→there, this→that, these→those。
come→go, bring→take。
例：He said, 'I'll come here tomorrow.' → He said that he would go there the next day.
注意：当天转述今天的事，时间词不变。

examples.en: He said, 'I came yesterday.'
He said he had come the day before.

topics.title: 间接引语情态动词变化
topics.summary: can→could, may→might, must→had to等变化
topics.detail:
情态动词的变化(主句过去时)：
can→could: He said, 'I can swim.' → He said he could swim.
may→might: She said, 'I may come.' → She said she might come.
must→had to: He said, 'I must go.' → He said he had to go.
will→would: She said, 'I will help.' → She said she would help.
shall→should: He said, 'I shall return.' → He said he should return.
注意：
- could/would/might/should/ought to不变。
- must表推测时不变：He said it must be true.
- had better不变：She said I had better go.

examples.en: He said he could swim.
She said she had to go.

topics.title: 间接引语特殊用法
topics.summary: 间接引语的特殊情况和注意事项
topics.detail:
特殊用法：
1. 客观真理不变：He said the earth is round.
2. 当天转述不变时态：He said he is busy today.
3. 过去完成时不变：He said he had finished.
4. could/would/might/should不变。
5. 引导动词多样：explain, admit, deny, suggest, promise, complain, warn。
   He admitted that he was wrong.
   She denied having seen him.
   He promised to help me.
6. 间接疑问句vs直接疑问句：I wonder where he lives.(间接) vs Where does he live?(直接)
7. 自由间接引语(无引导词)：He was tired. He wanted to go home。

examples.en: He admitted that he was wrong.
She promised to help me.

topics.title: 关系代词放句末
topics.summary: 介词可放从句末，关系代词省略
topics.detail:
介词可放在从句末尾，此时关系代词用that/who/which或省略：
The house (that) I live in is old. = The house in which I live is old.
The man (who) I spoke to is a doctor. = The man to whom I spoke is a doctor.
口语中常用介词放句末并省略关系代词。
正式书面语中介词放关系代词前。

examples.en: The book I'm reading is good.
The man I spoke to left.

topics.title: 关系词指代整句
topics.summary: which可指代整个主句内容
topics.detail:
非限制性定语从句中which可指代整个前句：
He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
She came late, which annoyed the teacher.
He said nothing, which was wise.
注意：that不能指代整句。
as也可指代整句：As is known to all, he is honest.
区别：which放主句后；as可放主句前或后。

examples.en: He passed, which made us happy.
examples.cn: 他通过了，这让我们高兴。

examples.en: As is known to all, he is honest.

topics.title: 关系代词前加量词
topics.summary: 关系代词前可加数词/量词修饰
topics.detail:
关系代词前可加数量词：
I have three books, two of which are novels.
He has many friends, some of whom are doctors.
The team has ten members, most of whom are young.
结构：名词/代词 + of + which/whom。
也可用whose+名词替代：the books whose covers are red。

examples.en: I have three books, two of which are novels.
examples.cn: 我有三本书，其中两本是小说。

examples.en: He has many friends, some of whom are doctors.
examples.cn: 他有很多朋友，有些是医生。

topics.title: 地点状语从句wherever
topics.summary: wherever表'无论哪里'，引导让步地点从句
topics.detail:
wherever引导地点/让步状语从句：
Wherever you go, I'll follow you.
Sit wherever you like.
Wherever there is water, there is life.
类似：everywhere, anywhere。
注意：wherever可表地点(任何地方)或让步(无论哪里)。
=no matter where。

examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow.
Sit wherever you like.

topics.title: 让步as/though倒装
topics.summary: as/though引导让步从句可倒装
topics.detail:
as和though引导让步从句时可倒装(表强调)：
1. 形容词/副词/名词 + as + 主语 + 谓语：
   Tired as he was, he kept working.(=Although he was tired)
   Child as he is, he knows a lot.
2. 动词原形 + as + 主语 + 助动词：
   Try as he might, he failed.
注意：名词提前时不加冠词：Child as he is(不说A child as he is)。
though也可这样用，但although不可以。

examples.en: Tired as he was, he kept working.
Child as he is, he knows a lot.
examples.cn: 虽然还是孩子，他知道很多。

topics.title: 否定目的状语从句
topics.summary: so that...not/in order that...not表否定目的
topics.detail:
否定目的从句：
He spoke loudly so that everyone could hear.
He whispered so that no one could hear.(否定目的)
= He whispered in order that no one should hear.
也可用lest(以免)：He ran lest he should miss the train.
lest后常用should(虚拟语气)。
for fear that(生怕)：He left early for fear that he might be late.

examples.en: He whispered so that no one could hear.
examples.cn: 他低声说以免有人听到。

examples.en: He ran lest he should miss the train.

topics.title: whether+to do
topics.summary: whether后可接不定式表'是否要'
topics.detail:
whether后接不定式：
I don't know whether to go or stay.
She wondered whether to accept the offer.
I can't decide whether to buy it.
注意：if后不接不定式，只有whether可以。
what/where/when/how等也可接不定式：
I don't know what to do.
She doesn't know where to go.
I forget how to do it.

examples.en: I don't know whether to go.
She doesn't know what to do.

topics.title: doubt后的名词性从句
topics.summary: doubt后用if/whether，not doubt后用that
topics.detail:
doubt后引导词规则：
1. 肯定句doubt后用if/whether：I doubt if he will come.
2. 否定句/疑问句后用that：I don't doubt that he will come. / Do you doubt that he will come?
类似：sure/certain后用that；not sure后用if/whether。
I'm sure that he is right. / I'm not sure if he is right.
注意：there is no doubt that...用that。

examples.en: I doubt if he will come.
There is no doubt that he is honest.

topics.title: 双重定语从句
topics.summary: 一个先行词可被两个定语从句修饰
topics.detail:
双重定语从句：
The man who is standing there and who is wearing a blue suit is my teacher.
注意：
1. 两个从句用and/or/but连接。
2. 第二个从句的关系词不可省略。
3. 两个从句分别修饰同一先行词。
4. 也可分别修饰不同方面：The book that I bought which is about history is interesting.

examples.en: The man who is tall and who is wearing glasses is my teacher.
examples.cn: 又高又戴眼镜的那个人是我老师。

examples.en: This is the book that I bought which is about history.
examples.cn: 这是我买的关于历史的书。

topics.title: which指代整句详述
topics.summary: which在非限制性从句中可指代前文整句内容
topics.detail:
which指代整个前句的用法详述：
He came late, which annoyed the teacher.(which=他迟到这件事)
She smiled, which was rare.(which=她微笑这件事)
He refused to help, which surprised everyone.
注意：
- which指代整句时用单数谓语。
- 不能用that替代。
- 可加限定词：He failed, at which point he gave up.
- in which case, by which time等固定搭配。

examples.en: He came late, which annoyed the teacher.
examples.cn: 他迟到了，这让老师生气。

examples.en: She smiled, which was rare.

topics.title: 结果状语从句so...that详述
topics.summary: so+adj/adv+that表'如此…以至于'
topics.detail:
so...that引导结果从句：
so + 形容词/副词 + that从句。
It was so cold that I shivered.
He spoke so fast that I couldn't understand.
so + 形容词 + a/an + 名词 + that：so beautiful a day that...
so that(以便/结果是)：I got up early so that I could catch the train.
so as to(以便)：I got up early so as to catch the train.
so...as to(如此…以至于)：He was so kind as to help me.

examples.en: It was so cold that I shivered.
He spoke so fast that I couldn't follow.

topics.title: 间接引语感叹句
topics.summary: 感叹句转间接引语用what/how引导
topics.detail:
感叹句的转换：
He said, 'What a beautiful day!' → He exclaimed what a beautiful day it was.
She said, 'How wonderful!' → She exclaimed how wonderful it was.
注意：
1. 引导词用what/how保留。
2. 时态和人称变化同陈述句。
3. 引导动词可用exclaim, say等。
4. 感叹词(oh, ah等)省略。

examples.en: He exclaimed what a beautiful day it was.
She said how wonderful it was.

topics.title: 混合间接引语
topics.summary: 多种类型混合的间接引语转换
topics.detail:
混合类型的间接引语：
1. 陈述+疑问：He said he was tired and asked if I was too.
2. 陈述+祈使：She said she was busy and told me to wait.
3. 混合人称/时态：He told me that he had seen her yesterday and that she was fine.
注意：
- 各部分分别按类型转换。
- 保持人称和时态的一致性。
- 常用and/but连接各部分。

examples.en: He said he was tired and asked if I could help.
examples.cn: 他说他累了并问我能否帮忙。

examples.en: She said she was busy and told me to wait.

topics.title: 虚拟语气wish
topics.summary: wish+过去时表与现在相反愿望，wish+过去完成时表与过去相反
topics.detail:
wish引导虚拟语气：
1. wish + 过去时(与现在相反)：I wish I were rich.
2. wish + 过去完成时(与过去相反)：I wish I had studied harder.
3. wish + would/could(与将来相反/希望)：I wish you would stop talking.
注意：wish表难以实现的愿望；hope表可能实现：I hope you can come.
were不分人称：I wish I were/I wish she were.

examples.en: I wish I were taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
examples.cn: 我真希望我当时更努力。

topics.title: if only虚拟
topics.summary: if only+虚拟语气表强烈愿望或遗憾
topics.detail:
if only引导虚拟语气，表'要是…就好了'：
1. if only + 过去时(现在)：If only I knew the answer!
2. if only + 过去完成时(过去)：If only I had listened to you!
3. if only + would(将来)：If only it would stop raining!
比wish语气更强，常单独成句。
if only和I wish可互换，但if only更强调感情。

examples.en: If only I knew the answer!
examples.cn: 要是我知道答案就好了！

examples.en: If only I had listened to you!
examples.cn: 要是我听了你的话就好了！

topics.title: as if虚拟
topics.summary: as if/though后用虚拟语气表与事实相反
topics.detail:
as if/though后接虚拟语气表非真实情况：
1. 过去时(与现在相反)：He talks as if he knew everything.
2. 过去完成时(与过去相反)：He looks as if he had seen a ghost.
注意：如果可能为真，不用虚拟：
He looks as if he is ill.(可能真病了)
He talks as if he were the boss.(实际上不是)
were用于所有人称(正式)。

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.cn: 他说话好像什么都知道。

examples.en: She looks as if she had seen a ghost.

topics.title: would rather虚拟
topics.summary: would rather+过去时表宁愿他人做某事
topics.detail:
would rather的虚拟用法：
1. would rather + 动词原形(自己)：I would rather stay home.
2. would rather + 过去时(他人)：I would rather you didn't smoke.
3. would rather + 过去完成时(过去)：I would rather you hadn't said that.
注意：
- would rather do than do：I'd rather walk than take a bus.
- would rather后接从句用虚拟语气。
- 主语与would rather之间用'd缩写。

examples.en: I would rather stay home.
I would rather you didn't smoke.

topics.title: it is (high) time虚拟
topics.summary: it is time+过去时表'该做某事了'
topics.detail:
it is (high/about) time + 过去时(虚拟)：
It is time we went home.
It is high time you stopped smoking.
It is about time she found a job.
注意：
- 用过去时表虚拟(现在该做但还没做)。
- 也可接to do：It is time to go home.
- 区别：It is time we went(虚拟,强调该做了) vs It is time for us to go(不定式)。

examples.en: It is time we went home.
It is high time you stopped smoking.

topics.title: suggest类动词虚拟
topics.summary: suggest/demand/insist等后用(should)+动词原形
topics.detail:
suggest类动词后的虚拟语气：
动词：suggest, demand, insist, require, request, order, propose, advise, recommend, urge。
结构：主语 + (should) + 动词原形。
He suggested that we (should) leave early.
She demanded that he apologize.
The doctor advised that he take a rest.
注意：should可省略(美式常省)。
否定：suggest that he (should) not go.
被动：It is suggested that he (should) be punished.

examples.en: He suggested that we leave early.
She insisted that he apologize.

topics.title: 形容词后虚拟
topics.summary: essential/important/necessary等后用虚拟
topics.detail:
形容词后的虚拟语气：
It is + 形容词 + that + (should) + 动词原形。
形容词：essential, important, necessary, vital, crucial, imperative, urgent, desirable, advisable。
It is essential that everyone (should) be informed.
It is important that he (should) arrive on time.
It is necessary that she (should) take the medicine.
It is imperative that we (should) act now.
should可省略。

examples.en: It is essential that everyone be informed.
It is important that he arrive on time.

topics.title: 真实条件句Type 1
topics.summary: If+现在时,主句will+V表可能发生的条件
topics.detail:
Type 1真实条件句：
If + 一般现在时, 主句 + will/won't + 动词原形。
If it rains, I will stay home.
If you study hard, you will pass.
If he comes, I'll tell him.
注意：
- 表可能发生的条件。
- 从句用现在时(主将从现)。
- 可用can/may/should/must替代will。
- 除非unless = if...not：Unless you hurry, you'll be late.

examples.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.
If you study hard, you'll pass.

topics.title: 非真实条件句Type 2
topics.summary: If+过去时,主句would+V表与现在相反的假设
topics.detail:
Type 2非真实条件句(与现在相反)：
If + 一般过去时, 主句 + would/could/might + 动词原形。
If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If I had time, I would help you.
If she knew, she would tell us.
注意：
- were用于所有人称(正式)。
- 表与现在事实相反的假设。
- If I were you, I would...(常用建议句型)。

examples.en: If I were rich, I would travel.
examples.cn: 如果我有钱，我会去旅行。

examples.en: If I were you, I would go.

topics.title: 虚拟条件句Type 3
topics.summary: If+过去完成时,主句would have+done表与过去相反
topics.detail:
Type 3虚拟条件句(与过去相反)：
If + 过去完成时, 主句 + would/could/might + have + 过去分词。
If I had known, I would have helped.
If she had studied, she would have passed.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
注意：
- 表与过去事实相反的假设。
- 常表遗憾：If only I had..., I would have...
- 省略if需倒装：Had I known, I would have helped.

examples.en: If I had known, I would have helped.
examples.cn: 如果我知道，我会帮忙的。

examples.en: If she had studied, she would have passed.
examples.cn: 如果她学了，就会通过的。

topics.title: 混合条件句
topics.summary: 条件与结果分属不同时间
topics.detail:
混合条件句(条件与结果时间不同)：
1. 过去条件+现在结果：If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
