2. 现在条件+过去结果：If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
注意：
- 根据实际意义选择时态。
- 条件和结果可以分属不同时间。
- 常用now, then等时间词明确时间。

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now.
examples.cn: 如果我更努力学习，现在就有更好的工作。

examples.en: If I were rich, I would have bought it.

topics.title: 虚拟条件句倒装
topics.summary: 省略if时had/were/should提前倒装
topics.detail:
虚拟条件句省略if时倒装：
1. had提前(Type 3)：Had I known, I would have helped. = If I had known...
2. were提前(Type 2)：Were I rich, I would travel. = If I were rich...
3. should提前(Type 1,较正式)：Should it rain, I would stay. = If it should rain...
注意：
- 只有had/were/should可提前。
- if省略后主语和助动词倒装。
- 用于正式书面语。

examples.en: Had I known, I would have helped.
Were I rich, I would travel.
examples.cn: 如果我有钱，我会去旅行。

topics.title: without/but for虚拟
topics.summary: without/but for + 名词引出虚拟条件
topics.detail:
without和but for引出虚拟条件：
Without your help, I would have failed. = If you hadn't helped me.
But for the rain, we would have gone out.
But for your advice, I would have made a mistake.
类似：but that(若非)：But that I saw it, I wouldn't have believed it.
注意：without/but for后接名词，不接从句。
根据语境用would do(现在)或would have done(过去)。

examples.en: Without your help, I would have failed.
examples.cn: 没有你的帮助，我就失败了。

examples.en: But for the rain, we would have gone out.
examples.cn: 要不是下雨，我们就出去了。

topics.title: 可分短语动词
topics.summary: 可分短语动词的宾语可放中间或后面
topics.detail:
可分短语动词(catch词可分开)：
1. 宾语是名词：可放中间或后面。Turn on the light. = Turn the light on.
2. 宾语是代词：必须放中间。Turn it on. (不说Turn on it.)
3. 常见可分短语动词：turn on/off, put on, take off, pick up, look up, give up, try on, put off, throw away。
注意：代词宾语必须放中间。

examples.en: Turn on the light.
Turn it on.

topics.title: 不可分短语动词
topics.summary: 不可分短语动词的宾语放后面，不可拆开
topics.detail:
不可分短语动词(不能分开)：
1. 宾语放后面，不可放中间。
2. 常见不可分短语动词：look for, look after, listen to, wait for, belong to, depend on, rely on, insist on, consist of, look at。
3. 代词宾语也放后面：Look for it. (不说Look it for.)
4. 三词短语动词不可分：look forward to, put up with, get along with, run out of。

examples.en: I'm looking for my keys.
She looks after the children.

topics.title: 常见短语动词搭配
topics.summary: 常用短语动词及其意义
topics.detail:
常见短语动词：
give up(放弃), take off(起飞/脱下), look up(查阅), put off(推迟), pick up(捡起/接人), turn down(拒绝/调小), work out(锻炼/解决), figure out(弄明白), get along(相处), break down(出故障), bring up(抚养), come across(偶遇), set up(建立), carry on(继续), look forward to(期待)。

examples.en: Don't give up on your dreams.
I look forward to seeing you.

topics.title: 接不定式的动词
topics.summary: want/decide/hope等后接to do
topics.detail:
接不定式(to do)的动词：
want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, refuse, offer, manage, fail, choose, expect, wish, learn, pretend, seem, appear, happen, afford, determine, threaten。
I decided to leave. / She hopes to win. / He promised to help.
不定式完成式：He seems to have left. / She is said to be rich.

examples.en: I decided to leave early.
She hopes to win the prize.

topics.title: 接动名词的动词
topics.summary: enjoy/finish/mind等后接doing
topics.detail:
接动名词(doing)的动词：
enjoy, finish, mind, practice, avoid, suggest, consider, keep, stop, deny, admit, imagine, risk, miss, postpone, resist, appreciate, delay, involve, escape。
I enjoy reading. / She finished cooking. / Would you mind closing the door?
注意：stop doing(停止做) vs stop to do(停下来去做)。

examples.en: I enjoy reading novels.
Would you mind closing the door?

topics.title: 既接to do又接doing的动词
topics.summary: remember/forget/stop等接to do和doing意义不同
topics.detail:
意义不同的动词：
1. remember to do(记得要做) vs remember doing(记得做过)。
   Remember to lock the door. / I remember locking the door.
2. forget to do(忘记要做) vs forget doing(忘记做过)。
   Don't forget to call. / I'll never forget meeting her.
3. stop to do(停下来去做) vs stop doing(停止做)。
   He stopped to smoke. / He stopped smoking.
4. try to do(努力做) vs try doing(试着做)。
   Try to open it. / Try opening it.
5. regret to do(遗憾要做) vs regret doing(后悔做过)。
   I regret to tell you... / I regret telling you.

examples.en: Remember to lock the door.
I remember locking the door.

topics.title: 接宾语+不定式
topics.summary: tell/ask/want sb to do
topics.detail:
接宾语+不定式的动词：
tell, ask, want, order, advise, allow, permit, invite, encourage, expect, force, teach, warn, remind, persuade, enable, require, cause。
He told me to wait. / She asked me to help. / I want you to know.
否定：tell sb not to do. He told me not to be late.
注意：let/make/have后接不带to的不定式。

examples.en: He told me to wait.
She asked me not to be late.

topics.title: 接不带to不定式
topics.summary: make/let/have sb do
topics.detail:
接不带to不定式的动词：
1. make sb do：He made me cry. (不说made me to cry)
2. let sb do：She let me go.
3. have sb do：I had him fix the car.
注意：
- 被动语态中to要恢复：I was made to cry.
- help后可接to do或do：He helped me (to) clean.
- see/hear/watch sb do(全过程)/doing(正在)。

examples.en: He made me laugh.
She let me go early.

topics.title: 完成不定式
topics.summary: to have done表已完成或过去的动作
topics.detail:
完成不定式(to have done)：
1. 表已完成：He seems to have left. = It seems that he has left.
2. 表过去：She is said to have written three books. = It is said that she has written...
3. 否定：not to have done。
4. 完成进行：to have been doing。
注意：完成不定式所表动作先于主句动词发生。
I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. = I'm sorry that I have kept you waiting.

examples.en: He seems to have left.
She is said to have written three books.

topics.title: 被动不定式详述
topics.summary: to be done表被动
topics.detail:
被动不定式(to be done)：
1. 表被动：He wants to be promoted.
2. 完成被动：to have been done。
   The letter seems to have been sent.
3. 否定：not to be done。
注意：
- 主动表被动：This house is to let(出租). / Blame is to be borne.
- there be不定式：There is nothing to do(没事做). / There is nothing to be done(没办法了).

examples.en: He wants to be promoted.
The letter seems to have been sent.

topics.title: 完成动名词
topics.summary: having done表在主句动作之前发生
topics.detail:
完成动名词(having done)：
1. 表先于主句动作：Having finished his homework, he went out.
2. 完成被动：having been done。
   Having been told the news, she was happy.
3. 否定：not having done。
   Not having received a reply, I wrote again.
注意：
- 一般动名词(doing)和完成动名词(having done)都表先于主句。
- 完成动名词强调时间先后。
- regret having done = regret doing(后悔做了)。

examples.en: Having finished his work, he went home.
Not having received a reply, I wrote again.

topics.title: 被动动名词详述
topics.summary: being done表被动进行
topics.detail:
被动动名词(being done)：
1. 表被动：He dislikes being criticized.
2. 完成被动：having been done。
3. 否定：not being done。
注意：
- need/want/deserve/require + doing = being done(主动表被动)。
  My car needs washing. = My car needs to be washed.
- worth + doing(主动表被动)：The book is worth reading.

examples.en: He dislikes being criticized.
My car needs washing.

topics.title: 完成分词详述
topics.summary: having done作状语表先于主句动作
topics.detail:
完成分词(having done)：
1. 作状语表时间/原因：Having finished his work, he went home. / Having lived here for years, he knows the place well.
2. 完成被动：having been done。Having been invited, he attended the party.
3. 否定：not having done。Not having enough money, he couldn't buy it.
注意：
- 分词的逻辑主语须与主句主语一致。
- 完成分词强调先于主句动作。
- 一般分词也可表先后：Finishing his work, he went home.

examples.en: Having finished his work, he went home.
Having been invited, he came to the party.
examples.cn: 被邀请后他来参加了聚会。

topics.title: 被动分词详述
topics.summary: done表被动和完成
topics.detail:
过去分词(done)的用法：
1. 作定语(表被动/完成)：broken glass, fallen leaves, written language。
2. 作表语：He was excited. / The door is closed.
3. 作状语：Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful.
4. 作宾补：I had my hair cut. / He found the window broken.
注意：
- 及物动词的过去分词表被动。
- 不及物动词的过去分词表完成：fallen leaves(已落的叶)。
- being done表正在被做。

examples.en: Seen from the hill, the city is beautiful.
He found the window broken.

topics.title: 独立主格详述
topics.summary: 名词+分词有自己的逻辑主语
topics.detail:
独立主格结构：
1. 名词/代词 + 分词：Weather permitting, we'll go out. (weather是permitting的逻辑主语)
2. 名词/代词 + 形容词：He stood there, his eyes wide.
3. 名词/代词 + 介词短语：She entered, a smile on her face.
4. 名词/代词 + 副词：The meeting over, everyone left.
5. with + 名词 + 补语：He slept with the window open.
注意：独立主格的主语与主句主语不同，表伴随/时间/原因/条件。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we'll go out.
The meeting over, everyone left.

topics.title: with复合结构详述
topics.summary: with+宾语+补语(分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词)
topics.detail:
with复合结构：
1. with + 名词 + 形容词：He slept with the window open.
2. with + 名词 + 副词：She left with the light on.
3. with + 名词 + 介词短语：He came in with a book in his hand.
4. with + 名词 + 现在分词(主动)：With him standing there, I felt nervous.
5. with + 名词 + 过去分词(被动/完成)：With the work finished, he went home.
6. with + 名词 + 不定式(将来)：With so much work to do, I can't rest.
用法：表伴随/方式/原因/条件。

examples.en: He slept with the window open.
With the work done, he relaxed.

topics.title: 反义疑问句基础
topics.summary: 前肯后否/前否后肯，用助动词和代词
topics.detail:
反义疑问句基本规则：
1. 前肯后否：He is a teacher, isn't he?
2. 前否后肯：She doesn't like tea, does she?
3. 用助动词(be/do/have/情态)：You can swim, can't you?
4. 代词代替名词：Tom is here, isn't he? (不说isn't Tom?)
5. 时态一致：You went there, didn't you?
注意：
- there be句型：There is a book, isn't there?
- let's开头用shall we：Let's go, shall we?
- 祈使句用will you：Open the door, will you?

examples.en: He is a teacher, isn't he?
You don't like tea, do you?

topics.title: 反义疑问句特殊
topics.summary: nothing/never/nobody否定词后用肯定
topics.detail:
反义疑问句特殊情况：
1. 含否定词(no/nothing/never/nobody/hardly/seldom)：
   He never lies, does he? (前否后肯)
   Nobody knows, do they?
2. 含un-/in-/dis-等否定前缀的词不算否定：
   He is unhappy, isn't he? (unhappy不算否定)
3. I think/suppose/believe后：
   I think he is right, isn't he? (问从句)
   I don't think he is right, is he?
4. everything/anything用it：Everything is fine, isn't it?
5. everyone/everybody用they：Everyone is here, aren't they?

examples.en: He never lies, does he?
I think he is right, isn't he?

topics.title: 祈使句反义疑问
topics.summary: 祈使句后用will you/won't you
topics.detail:
祈使句的反义疑问句：
1. 肯定祈使句：Open the door, will you? / won't you?
2. 否定祈使句：Don't open the door, will you?
3. Let's开头：Let's go, shall we? (含说话人)
4. Let us开头：Let us go, will you? (不含听话人)
注意：
- will you表请求；won't you表邀请。
- shall we仅用于Let's。
- 也可用can you/could you使语气更委婉。

examples.en: Open the door, will you?
Let's go, shall we?

topics.title: do/does/did强调
topics.summary: 用do/does/did强调谓语动词
topics.detail:
强调谓语动词：
1. 强调现在时：I do like it. / She does work hard.
2. 强调过去时：He did come yesterday.
3. 强调祈使句：Do be careful! / Do sit down!
注意：
- do/does/did后接动词原形。
- 只强调肯定句，不用于否定句/疑问句。
- 常用于反驳或强调：— You don't like it. — I do like it!

examples.en: I do like this movie.
He did come yesterday.

topics.title: 强调位置
topics.summary: 通过词序变化强调句中成分
topics.detail:
通过位置变化强调：
1. 宾语前置：This I must see. / Money he has none.
2. 状语前置：Yesterday I saw him. / In the room sat a boy.
3. 倒装强调：Never have I seen such a thing.
4. 分裂句强调：It was Tom who broke the window.
5. 助动词强调：I am trying. / Do be careful.
注意：前置成分通常有对比或强调意味。

examples.en: This I must see.
Never have I seen such beauty.

topics.title: 并列句
topics.summary: 用and/but/or/so等连接两个独立分句
topics.detail:
并列句由并列连词连接两个或以上独立分句：
1. and(并列)：I like tea and he likes coffee.
2. but(转折)：He is rich but unhappy.
3. or(选择)：Hurry up or you'll be late.
4. so(因果)：It rained, so I stayed home.
5. for(原因)：He must be ill, for he looks pale.
6. yet(转折)：She tried hard, yet she failed.
7. nor(否定并列)：He can't sing, nor can he dance.
注意：分句间用逗号分隔。

examples.en: I like tea and he likes coffee.
Hurry up, or you'll be late.

topics.title: 平行结构
topics.summary: 用相同语法结构保持句子平衡
topics.detail:
平行结构要求并列成分语法形式一致：
1. 动词并列：She likes reading, writing, and swimming.
2. 不定式并列：I want to eat, to sleep, and to play.
3. 形容词并列：He is tall, strong, and handsome.
4. 介词短语并列：in the morning, at noon, and in the evening.
5. 从句并列：that he came, that he helped, and that he left.
注意：not only...but also, either...or, neither...nor等关联连词也要求平行。

examples.en: She likes reading, writing, and swimming.
examples.cn: 她喜欢阅读、写作和游泳。

examples.en: He is tall, strong, and handsome.

topics.title: 隐喻Metaphor
topics.summary: 直接把A说成B，不用like/as
topics.detail: 隐喻不使用like/as，直接将一物说成另一物，隐含比较。增强表达力和形象感。

examples.en: Time is money.

topics.title: 明喻Simile
topics.summary: 用like/as将两物相比
topics.detail: 明喻用like/as/as...as进行明确比较：as brave as a lion。

examples.en: She is as busy as a bee.

topics.title: 拟人Personification
topics.summary: 赋予非人事物以人的特征
topics.detail: 拟人把无生命事物赋予人的行为或情感。

examples.en: The wind whispered through the trees.

topics.title: 夸张Hyperbole
topics.summary: 故意夸大或缩小
topics.detail: 夸张为强调效果故意言过其实。

examples.en: I've told you a million times.
examples.cn: 我跟你说过一百万次了。

topics.title: 反语Irony
topics.summary: 正话反说，字面与实际相反
topics.detail: 反语说出的话与真实意思相反，含讽刺意味。

examples.en: What a wonderful day to be stuck in traffic.

topics.title: 讽刺Sarcasm
topics.summary: 用尖刻话语嘲讽
topics.detail: 讽刺用尖刻话语直接嘲讽，常伤人。

examples.en: Nice going, genius.

topics.title: 间接肯定Litotes
topics.summary: 用否定反义词来肯定
topics.detail: Litotes用双重否定或否定反义词表肯定：not bad=good。

examples.en: He's not unkind.

topics.title: 转喻Metonymy
topics.summary: 用相关事物代本体
topics.detail: 转喻用相关事物代替本体：the crown=王权，the White House=美国政府。

examples.en: The pen is mightier than the sword.

topics.title: 提喻Synecdoche
topics.summary: 以部分代整体或整体代部分
topics.detail: 提喻用部分代整体(all hands=所有船员)或整体代部分。

examples.en: He bought new wheels.

topics.title: 矛盾修饰Oxymoron
topics.summary: 矛盾词语并列
topics.detail: 矛盾修饰将反义词并列：bittersweet, living death。

examples.en: It was a bittersweet memory.

topics.title: 悖论Paradox
topics.summary: 看似矛盾实含真理
topics.detail: 悖论看似自相矛盾却含真理：Less is more。

examples.en: The child is father of the man.

topics.title: 对偶Antithesis
topics.summary: 用并列结构对比相反概念
topics.detail: 对偶用平行结构对比相反概念：To err is human; to forgive, divine。

examples.en: Speech is silver, silence is golden.

topics.title: 交错配列Chiasmus
topics.summary: ABBA交叉结构
topics.detail: 交错配列将词序交叉排列：Ask not what your country can do for you—ask what you can do for your country。

examples.en: You can take the boy out of the country, but you can't take the country out of the boy.
examples.cn: 你可以让男孩离开乡村，但乡村不会离开男孩。

topics.title: 首语重复Anaphora
topics.summary: 句首重复相同词组
topics.detail: 首语重复在连续句首重复同一词组，增强气势。

examples.en: I have a dream that one day... I have a dream that...
examples.cn: 我有一个梦想……我有一个梦想……

topics.title: 尾词重复Epistrophe
topics.summary: 句末重复相同词
topics.detail: 尾词重复在句末重复同一词。

examples.en: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child.
examples.cn: 作孩子时，我说话像孩子，理解像孩子。

topics.title: 呼语Apostrophe
topics.summary: 对不在场者或抽象事物说话
topics.detail: 呼语对不在场的人、神或抽象事物直接呼告。

examples.en: O Death, where is thy sting?
examples.cn: 死亡啊，你的毒钩在哪里？

topics.title: 委婉语Euphemism
topics.summary: 用温和词替代刺耳词
topics.detail: 委婉语用温和词汇替代冒犯或不愉快词语：pass away=die。

examples.en: He passed away last night.

topics.title: 头韵Alliteration
topics.summary: 首辅音重复
topics.detail: 头韵重复词首辅音，增强音韵效果。

examples.en: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
examples.cn: 彼得·派珀捡了一配克腌胡椒。

topics.title: 元音谐音Assonance
topics.summary: 元音重复
topics.detail: 元音谐音重复相同元音。

examples.en: The rain in Spain falls mainly on the plain.
examples.cn: 西班牙的雨主要落在平原上。

topics.title: 拟声Onomatopoeia
topics.summary: 词模拟自然声音
topics.detail: 拟声词模仿自然声音：buzz, hiss, splash, cuckoo。

examples.en: The bees buzzed and the snake hissed.

topics.title: 简单句Simple
topics.summary: 一个主谓结构
topics.detail: 简单句只含一个独立主谓结构，表达单一完整意思。

examples.en: The cat sat on the mat.

topics.title: 并列句Compound
topics.summary: 用连词连接独立分句
topics.detail: 并列句用and/but/or/so等连接两个或以上独立分句。

examples.en: She sang and he danced.

topics.title: 复合句Complex
topics.summary: 独立分句+从句
topics.detail: 复合句含一个独立分句和一个或以上从句。

examples.en: When she arrived, the meeting had started.

topics.title: 并列复合句
topics.summary: 并列+复合结构
topics.detail: 并列复合句含两个以上独立分句和一个以上从句。

examples.en: She sang, and he danced because it was a party.
examples.cn: 她唱歌，他跳舞因为那是派对。

topics.title: 圆周句Periodic
topics.summary: 主句在末尾，制造悬念
topics.detail: 圆周句把主要信息放句末，前面铺垫，制造悬念。

examples.en: Despite the rain, the cold, and the lateness of the hour, she came.
examples.cn: 尽管下雨寒冷夜深，她还是来了。

topics.title: 松散句Loose
topics.summary: 主句在前，补充在后
topics.detail: 松散句主句在前，后续信息逐层补充，自然平易。

examples.en: She came, despite the rain, the cold, and the hour.
examples.cn: 她来了，尽管下雨寒冷夜深。

topics.title: 平衡句Balanced
topics.summary: 两个对等分句对称
topics.detail: 平衡句两个结构对称的分句，常用于对比。

examples.en: To err is human; to forgive, divine.
examples.cn: 犯错是人之常情，宽恕是神圣的。

topics.title: 累积句Cumulative
topics.summary: 主句后接多个补充短语
topics.detail: 累积句主句后接递增的修饰短语，层层展开细节。

examples.en: He ran, breathless, determined, unstoppable.
examples.cn: 他跑着，气喘吁吁，决心坚定，不可阻挡。

topics.title: 悬念句Suspended
topics.summary: 关键信息延后
topics.detail: 悬念句把关键信息延后揭示。

examples.en: The winner of the contest, after hours of deliberation, was finally announced.
examples.cn: 经过数小时审议，比赛获胜者终于公布。

topics.title: 对立句Antithetical
topics.summary: 并列结构中对比对立
topics.detail: 对立句在并列结构中对比两个对立概念。

examples.en: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
examples.cn: 那是最好的时代，那是最坏的时代。

topics.title: 递进过渡Additive
topics.summary: also, moreover, furthermore
topics.detail: 递进过渡词补充新信息：also, in addition, moreover, furthermore, besides。

examples.en: She is smart; moreover, she is hardworking.

topics.title: 转折过渡Adversative
topics.summary: however, nevertheless, yet
topics.detail: 转折过渡词表示对比或转折：however, nevertheless, on the other hand。

examples.en: He tried hard; however, he failed.
examples.cn: 他很努力；然而，他失败了。

topics.title: 因果过渡Causal
topics.summary: therefore, thus, consequently
topics.detail: 因果过渡词表示原因结果：therefore, thus, consequently, as a result。

examples.en: It rained; therefore, we stayed home.
examples.cn: 下雨了；因此我们待在家。

topics.title: 顺序过渡Sequential
topics.summary: first, then, next, finally
topics.detail: 顺序过渡词表示时间或逻辑顺序：first, second, then, next, finally。

examples.en: First, mix the flour; then, add eggs; finally, bake.
examples.cn: 先混合面粉；然后加蛋；最后烘焙。

topics.title: 举例过渡Illustrative
topics.summary: for example, for instance
topics.detail: 举例过渡词引出具体例证：for example, for instance, such as。

examples.en: Many fruits are red; for example, apples and cherries.
examples.cn: 很多水果是红的；例如苹果和樱桃。

topics.title: 总结过渡Concluding
topics.summary: in conclusion, to sum up
topics.detail: 总结过渡词引出结论：in conclusion, to sum up, in summary。

examples.en: In conclusion, we must act now.
examples.cn: 总之，我们必须立即行动。

topics.title: 概括过渡Summarizing
topics.summary: in short, overall, generally
topics.detail: 概括过渡词对前文进行概括：in short, overall, all in all。

examples.en: Overall, the project was a success.
examples.cn: 总体而言，项目是成功的。

topics.title: 强调过渡Emphasis
topics.summary: indeed, in fact, certainly
topics.detail: 强调过渡词突出重要信息：indeed, in fact, certainly, of course。

examples.en: He is, indeed, the best candidate.

topics.title: 比较过渡Comparison
topics.summary: similarly, likewise, equally
topics.detail: 比较过渡词指出相似：similarly, likewise, in the same way。

examples.en: She loves reading; similarly, her brother enjoys books.
examples.cn: 她爱阅读；同样，她哥哥也爱书。

topics.title: 对比过渡Contrast
topics.summary: in contrast, on the contrary
topics.detail: 对比过渡词指出差异：in contrast, on the contrary, conversely。

examples.en: Tom is tall; in contrast, Jerry is short.

topics.title: 条件过渡Condition
topics.summary: otherwise, if so, if not
topics.detail: 条件过渡词引出条件：otherwise, if so, if not, in that case。

examples.en: Hurry up; otherwise, you'll be late.

topics.title: 让步过渡Concession
topics.summary: granted, of course, admittedly
topics.detail: 让步过渡词承认某点：granted, admittedly, of course, to be sure。

examples.en: Admittedly, the plan has flaws.

topics.title: 目的过渡Purpose
topics.summary: for this purpose, to this end
topics.detail: 目的过渡词说明目的：for this purpose, to this end。

examples.en: We need funding; to this end, we'll apply for a grant.
examples.cn: 我们需要资金；为此，我们将申请拨款。

topics.title: 结果过渡Result
topics.summary: as a result, accordingly
topics.detail: 结果过渡词表示后果：as a result, accordingly, hence。

examples.en: He overslept; as a result, he missed the train.
examples.cn: 他睡过头；结果错过了火车。

topics.title: 换言过渡Reformulation
topics.summary: in other words, that is
topics.detail: 换言过渡词重新表述：in other words, that is, namely。

examples.en: He's a polyglot; in other words, he speaks many languages.
examples.cn: 他是通晓多语者；换言之，他会多种语言。

topics.title: 名词化Nominalization
topics.summary: 动词/形容词转为名词
topics.detail: 名词化将动词或形容词转为名词，使表达更正式抽象：decide→decision, important→importance。

examples.en: The decision was made quickly.

topics.title: 学术被动
topics.summary: 学术中多用被动强调过程
topics.detail: 学术写作多用被动语态，强调过程而非执行者。

examples.en: The experiment was conducted carefully.

topics.title: 模糊限制Hedging
topics.summary: 用may/might/seem等避免绝对
topics.detail: 模糊限制语避免绝对化断言：may, might, seem, tend to, suggest。

examples.en: The results may indicate a trend.
examples.cn: 结果可能表明一种趋势。

topics.title: 谨慎措辞Cautious Language
topics.summary: 避免过于肯定
topics.detail: 谨慎措辞用it seems/appears that, arguably, presumably。

examples.en: It appears that the theory is valid.
examples.cn: 这个理论似乎是有效的。

topics.title: 无人称结构Impersonal
topics.summary: 避免I/we，用it/there
topics.detail: 无人称结构避免主观：It is argued that... / There is evidence that...。

examples.en: It is widely believed that exercise is beneficial.
examples.cn: 人们普遍认为运动有益。

topics.title: 学术分裂句强调
topics.summary: It is X that...强调
topics.detail: 分裂句用于强调：It is collaboration that drives innovation。

examples.en: It is through practice that one masters a skill.
examples.cn: 正是通过练习才能掌握技能。

topics.title: 学术前置Fronting
topics.summary: 将重要信息前置
topics.detail: 前置把重要或对比信息放句首。

examples.en: This theory, Einstein proposed in 1905.
examples.cn: 这个理论，爱因斯坦于1905年提出。

topics.title: 正式倒装
topics.summary: 正式文体中倒装
topics.detail: 正式文体常用倒装：Rarely have we seen... / Not only did he...but...。

examples.en: Rarely has such a discovery been made.

topics.title: 正式虚拟
topics.summary: demand/insist后用虚拟
topics.detail: 正式文体中demand/insist/suggest/recommend后用should+原形或直接原形。

examples.en: The committee insisted that he resign.

topics.title: 独立短语Absolute Phrase
topics.summary: 名词+分词作状语
topics.detail: 独立短语(名词+分词)作状语，表伴随或补充。

examples.en: The meeting being over, everyone left.

topics.title: 分词短语
topics.summary: Ving/V-ed作状语定语
topics.detail: 分词短语作状语或定语，使句子紧凑。

examples.en: Having finished his work, he left.

topics.title: 同位语Appositive
topics.summary: 名词后补充说明
topics.detail: 同位语对前面名词补充说明，用逗号隔开。

examples.en: Beijing, the capital of China, is huge.

topics.title: 定语从句简化
topics.summary: 省略关系代词+be
topics.detail: 定语从句简化：The man (who is) standing there。

examples.en: The book written by him is popular.

topics.title: 悬垂修饰语Dangling Modifier
topics.summary: 分词逻辑主语与主句不一致
topics.detail: 悬垂修饰语的分词逻辑主语与主句主语不一致，属语法错误。

examples.en: Walking down the street, the trees were beautiful.(误)
examples.cn: 走在街上，树很美。（错误句）

topics.title: 错位修饰语Misplaced Modifier
topics.summary: 修饰语位置不当造成歧义
topics.detail: 错位修饰语位置不当导致歧义。

examples.en: She almost drove the car for six hours.(歧义)
examples.cn: 她几乎开了六小时车。（歧义）

topics.title: 言语行为Speech Acts
topics.summary: 语言即行为：陈述/命令/承诺
topics.detail: 言语行为理论：语言不仅是描述，也是行为(陈述/命令/承诺/道歉)。

examples.en: I promise to help.

topics.title: 会话含义Implicature
topics.summary: 言外之意
topics.detail: 会话含义理论：字面之外的含义，依赖语境推断。

examples.en: It's cold in here.（暗示关窗）

topics.title: 预设Presupposition
topics.summary: 说话前的背景假设
topics.detail: 预说是话语中已假定为真的背景信息。

examples.en: John stopped smoking.（预设John曾吸烟）
examples.cn: 约翰戒烟了。（预设他曾吸烟）

topics.title: 指示Deixis
topics.summary: this/here/now等依赖语境
topics.detail: 指示词(this/that/here/there/now/then)依赖语境确定所指。

examples.en: Come here now.

topics.title: 衔接Cohesion
topics.summary: 语法词汇手段连接语篇
topics.detail: 衔接用照应、替代、省略、连接词等手段连接语篇。

examples.en: She bought a book. It was good.

topics.title: 连贯Coherence
topics.summary: 语篇逻辑意义一致
topics.detail: 连贯指语篇在意义和逻辑上一致，不仅形式衔接。

examples.en: She loves animals. She works at a zoo.
examples.cn: 她爱动物。她在动物园工作。

topics.title: 语域Register
topics.summary: 语言正式程度随场合变化
topics.detail: 语域指语言随场合(正式/非正式/学术/口语)变化的程度。

examples.en: G'day mate!（口语）/ Good morning, sir.（正式）

topics.title: 体裁Genre
topics.summary: 文本类型决定结构
topics.detail: 体裁指文本类型(叙事/议论/说明/描写)，决定结构和语言。

examples.en: Once upon a time...（叙事体裁）

topics.title: 情态Modality
topics.summary: 表达可能性/必要性/义务
topics.detail: 情态表达说话人对命题的态度：可能性、必要性、义务。

examples.en: You must finish it today.

topics.title: 立场Stance
topics.summary: 表达作者态度
topics.detail: 立场表达作者对信息的评价和态度：certainly, perhaps, surprisingly。

examples.en: Surprisingly, he agreed.
examples.cn: 令人惊讶的是，他同意了。

topics.title: 列表平行
topics.summary: 并列项语法形式一致
topics.detail: 列表中并列项必须语法形式一致。

examples.en: She likes reading, writing, and swimming.
examples.cn: 她喜欢阅读、写作和游泳。

topics.title: 牛津逗号
topics.summary: 并列最后一项前的逗号
topics.detail: 牛津逗号是and前的逗号，避免歧义。

examples.en: I thank my parents, Ayn Rand, and God.
examples.cn: 我感谢我的父母、安·兰德和上帝。

topics.title: 分裂不定式
topics.summary: to与动词间插入副词
topics.detail: 分裂不定式在to和动词间插入副词，正式写作中尽量避免。

examples.en: To boldly go...（争议用法）

topics.title: 句子碎片Fragment
topics.summary: 不完整句子
topics.detail: 句子碎片缺少主语或谓语，不成完整句。

examples.en: Because I said so.（碎片）

topics.title: 连写句Run-on
topics.summary: 两句间无标点或连词
topics.detail: 连写句两个独立句间无标点或连词。

examples.en: It is late I must go.（连写误）

topics.title: 逗号粘连Comma Splice
topics.summary: 两独立句只用逗号连接
topics.detail: 逗号粘连错误地用逗号连接两个独立分句。

examples.en: It is late, I must go.（误）

topics.title: 一致性错误Agreement
topics.summary: 主谓/代词不一致
topics.detail: 主谓一致和代词一致错误。

examples.en: He don't know.（误，应为doesn't）

topics.title: 代词指代
topics.summary: 代词须有明确先行词
topics.detail: 代词必须有明确的先行词，否则造成歧义。

examples.en: When Tom met Jerry, he smiled.（he指谁？）
examples.cn: 汤姆遇到杰瑞时，他笑了。（he指谁？）

topics.title: 视角一致
topics.summary: 保持一致的人称视角
topics.detail: 句子中应保持一致的人称(第一/二/三人称)。

examples.en: If one studies hard, you will succeed.（误，人称不一致）
examples.cn: 如果努力学习，你就会成功。（错误）

topics.title: 时态一致
topics.summary: 段落内时态应一致
topics.detail: 段落内时态应保持一致，避免无谓跳跃。

examples.en: She walked in and sits down.（误，时态不一致）

topics.title: 大写规则
topics.summary: 句首/专有名词/I大写
topics.detail: 大写规则：句首字母、专有名词、代词I、标题实词大写。

examples.en: I live in Beijing.

topics.title: 标点基础
topics.summary: 句号/逗号/分号/冒号用法
topics.detail: 标点基础：句号结束陈述句；逗号分隔并列项；分号连接相关独立句；冒号引出解释。

examples.en: She bought apples, bananas, and oranges.
examples.cn: 她买了苹果、香蕉和橘子。

topics.title: 主动被动选择
topics.summary: 主动更直接，被动强调承受者
topics.detail: 主动语态更直接有力，被动语态强调动作承受者或执行者不重要。

examples.en: The committee approved the plan.（主动）/ The plan was approved.（被动）
examples.cn: 委员会批准了计划。/计划被批准了。

topics.title: 混合条件句(现在过去)
topics.summary: 主从时态不同
topics.detail: 混合条件句：If I had studied harder (过去), I would be richer now (现在)。主从时间不同。

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.cn: 如果我学医，现在就是医生了。

topics.title: 省略if
topics.summary: if省略+倒装
topics.detail: 正式条件句中省略if，用倒装：Had I known, I would have come. / Were I you, I would go. / Should it rain, I'll stay.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have come.

topics.title: 倒装条件句
topics.summary: had/were/should+主语+...
topics.detail: 倒装条件句：Had+S+done, Were+S+to do, Should+S+do。

examples.en: Were I you, I would accept.

topics.title: 含蓄条件句
topics.summary: 无if但有条件意
topics.detail: 含蓄条件句不出现if，但暗含条件：But for your help, I would have failed. / Without water, we would die. / I would have helped, but I was busy.

examples.en: But for your help, I would have failed.
examples.cn: 没有你的帮助，我就失败了。

topics.title: unless/provided/as long as
topics.summary: 其他条件连词
topics.detail: 其他条件连词：unless(除非), provided/providing that(只要), as long as(只要), on condition that(条件是), suppose/supposing(假设)。

examples.en: You can borrow it as long as you return it tomorrow.
examples.cn: 只要明天还，你就可以借。

topics.title: 否定词倒装
topics.summary: 否定词前置+助动词倒装
topics.detail: 否定词(negative_adverbial)放句首时主句倒装：Never/Seldom/Hardly/Rarely/Little/Scarcely+助动词+S。

examples.en: Never have I seen such beauty.

topics.title: only倒装
topics.summary: only+状语前置倒装
topics.detail: only+状语放句首时主句倒装：Only then/Only by/Only when+助动词+S。

examples.en: Only then did I understand.

topics.title: so/such倒装
topics.summary: so/such...that倒装
topics.detail: so+adj/adv或such+n放句首时，主句倒装：So beautiful was she that everyone stared. / Such was his anger that he left.

examples.en: So angry was he that he left.
examples.cn: 他如此生气以至于走了。

topics.title: here/there倒装
topics.summary: here/there+动词+主语
topics.detail: here/there放句首，动词在主语前(主语为名词时倒装，代词时不倒装)：Here comes the bus. / Here it comes.

examples.en: Here comes the train.

topics.title: 平衡倒装
topics.summary: 为平衡句子倒装
topics.detail: 为平衡句子或强调而倒装：On the table sat a cat. / Through the window came a beam of light. (介词短语前置)

examples.en: On the wall hung a picture.

topics.title: V+N+adj
topics.summary: 动词+宾语+形容词作宾补
topics.detail: V+N+adj(宾补)：make/keep/find/leave/paint+N+adj。

examples.en: She painted the door red.

topics.title: V+N+to do
topics.summary: 动词+宾语+不定式
topics.detail: V+N+to do：want/wish/ask/tell/allow+N+to do。

examples.en: I asked him to help.

topics.title: V+N+doing
topics.summary: 动词+宾语+现在分词
topics.detail: V+N+doing：keep/catch/find/leave+N+doing。

examples.en: I caught him stealing.

topics.title: V+N+do
topics.summary: 动词+宾语+原形
topics.detail: V+N+do(无to)：make/let/have/see/hear/watch+N+do。

examples.en: She made him cry.

topics.title: V+that从句
topics.summary: 动词+that宾语从句
topics.detail: V+that：think/believe/say/know/hope+that...。

examples.en: I think that he is right.

topics.title: V+wh+to do
topics.summary: 动词+疑问词+不定式
topics.detail: V+wh-+to do：know/decide/wonder/ask+wh-+to do。

examples.en: I don't know what to do.

topics.title: V+it+adj+to do
topics.summary: 动词+it+形容词+不定式
topics.detail: V+it+adj+to do：make/find/feel+it+adj+to do。

examples.en: I find it hard to learn Chinese.

topics.title: V+反身代词
topics.summary: 动词+反身代词
topics.detail: V+反身代词：enjoy/hurt/teach/introduce+oneself。

examples.en: She taught herself English.

topics.title: shall vs will
topics.summary: shall用于第一人称征求意见/承诺
topics.detail: shall用于第一人称征求意见(Shall I...?)或承诺/威胁(You shall get it)。will表将来或意愿。

examples.en: Shall we dance?

topics.title: should have done
topics.summary: 本该做却没做
topics.detail: should have done表过去本该做却没做，含责备。

examples.en: You should have told me.

topics.title: could have done
topics.summary: 本可以做却没做
topics.detail: could have done表过去本可以做却没做，表可能性或遗憾。

examples.en: I could have won.

topics.title: may have done
topics.summary: 可能已经做了
topics.detail: may have done表对过去事情的推测(可能已经)。

examples.en: He may have left already.

topics.title: must have done
topics.summary: 一定已经做了
topics.detail: must have done表对过去事情的肯定推测(一定已经)。

examples.en: You must have been tired.

topics.title: demand型虚拟
topics.summary: demand/insist/suggest后用虚拟
topics.detail: demand/insist/suggest/recommend/require/order+that+S+(should)+V原形。

examples.en: The doctor insisted that he rest.

topics.title: wish与过去相反
topics.summary: wish+过去完成时
topics.detail: wish+过去完成时表与过去事实相反的愿望：I wish I had studied harder. (真希望当时更努力)

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.

topics.title: as if/as though虚拟
topics.summary: as if+虚拟语气表非真实
topics.detail: as if/as though后用虚拟语气表非真实情况：He talks as if he knew everything. (其实不懂)

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.cn: 他说话好像什么都知道。

topics.title: It's time虚拟
topics.summary: It's (high) time+S+过去时
topics.detail: It's (high) time+S+过去时(虚拟)，表'该做某事了'。

examples.en: It's time we left.

topics.title: would rather虚拟
topics.summary: would rather+S+过去时
topics.detail: would rather+S+过去时(对现在/将来虚拟)：I'd rather you didn't smoke. / would rather+S+过去完成时(对过去)。

examples.en: I'd rather you didn't smoke.

topics.title: 省略从句
topics.summary: 省略主语或be
topics.detail: 省略从句：While (he was) reading, he fell asleep. / Though (he was) tired, he worked on.

examples.en: While reading, he fell asleep.

topics.title: 独立主格主格
topics.summary: 名词+分词有自己的逻辑主语
topics.detail: 独立主格：名词/代词+分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语，有自己的逻辑主语。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we'll go out.

topics.title: with独立结构
topics.summary: with+名词+补语
topics.detail: with+名词+分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语，表伴随。

examples.en: He slept with the window open.

topics.title: if only虚拟
topics.summary: if only+虚拟表强烈愿望
topics.detail: if only+虚拟语气表强烈愿望：If only I were younger! / If only I had listened!

examples.en: If only I were younger!

topics.title: It is high time
topics.summary: It is high time+S+过去时
topics.detail: It is high time+S+过去时，表'早该做某事了'。

examples.en: It is high time we left.
